quote: The activities of glutathione peroxidase in the hepatopancreas and intestine of the fish fed diets comprising 4.0 and 5.0 g/kg of the mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract were higher than other levels, respectively
statement: 饲喂含4.0和5.0 g/kg桑叶乙醚提取物的饲料后，鱼肝胰腺和肠道中的谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性分别高于其他水平。
text_zh: 饲喂含4.0和5.0 g/kg桑叶乙醚提取物的饲料后，鱼肝胰腺和肠道中的谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性分别高于其他水平。
text_en: After feeding diets containing 4.0 and 5.0 g/kg mulberry leaf ether extract, glutathione peroxidase activity in the fish hepatopancreas and intestine was higher than at other levels.

quote: the feed intake (FI) was significantly reduced under Cu exposure
statement: 在铜暴露条件下，采食量（FI）显著减少。
text_zh: 在铜暴露条件下，采食量（FI）显著减少。
text_en: Under copper exposure conditions, feed intake (FI) significantly decreased.

quote: Based on the broken-line analysis, the optimum dietary supplementation of the mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract was 4.52 g kg/diet, estimated using the feed intake of the crucian carp under Cu exposure
statement: 基于折线分析，利用铜暴露下鲫鱼的采食量估算，桑叶乙醚提取物的最佳膳食补充量为4.52 g/kg/日粮。
text_zh: 基于折线分析，利用铜暴露下鲫鱼的采食量估算，桑叶乙醚提取物的最佳膳食补充量为4.52 g/kg/日粮。
text_en: Based on breakpoint analysis, the optimal dietary supplementation level of ether extract of mulberry leaves was estimated to be 4.52 g/kg diet for crucian carp feed intake under copper exposure.

quote: Cu exposure led to a slight decrease in the lipase activity in the hepatopancreas of the crucian carp.
statement: 铜暴露导致鲫鱼肝胰腺中脂肪酶活性轻微下降。
text_zh: 铜暴露导致鲫鱼肝胰腺中脂肪酶活性轻微下降。
text_en: Copper exposure caused a slight decrease in lipase activity in the hepatopancreas of crucian carp.

quote: Based on the broken-line analysis, the optimum dietary supplementation of the mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract was 4.90 g kg/diet, estimated using the inhibitory rate of rollover (IR) for crucian carp under trichlorfon stress
statement: The optimal dietary supplementation level of mulberry leaf ethyl ether extract for crucian carp under trichlorfon stress is 4.90 g/kg diet.
text_en: The optimal dietary supplementation level of mulberry leaf ethyl ether extract for crucian carp under trichlorfon stress is 4.90 g/kg diet.

quote: trichlorfon stress led to a slight decrease in the anti-superoxide anion capacity in the crucian carp muscle
statement: Trichlorfon stress caused a slight decrease in the anti-superoxide anion capacity in crucian carp muscle.
text_en: Trichlorfon stress caused a slight decrease in the anti-superoxide anion capacity in crucian carp muscle.

quote: The activities of lactate dehydrogenase, glutamate–pyruvate transaminase, glutamate–oxaloacetate transaminase, catalase and glutathione reductase, as well as the capacity of the anti-hydroxyl radical, were significantly reduced under trichlorfon stress
statement: Trichlorfon stress significantly reduced the activities of several metabolic enzymes and antioxidant capacities in fish muscle.
text_en: Trichlorfon stress significantly reduced the activities of several metabolic enzymes and antioxidant capacities in fish muscle.

quote: Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract increased these parameters
statement: Dietary mulberry leaf ethyl ether extract increased the metabolic and antioxidant parameters that were reduced by trichlorfon stress.
text_en: Dietary mulberry leaf ethyl ether extract increased the metabolic and antioxidant parameters that were reduced by trichlorfon stress.

quote: The activities of glutathione reductase and the capacity of the anti-hydroxyl radical were significantly enhanced with the increase in the dietary levels of the mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract up to 4.0 g/kg
statement: Glutathione reductase activity and anti-hydroxyl radical capacity significantly increased with dietary mulberry leaf ethyl ether extract levels up to 4.0 g/kg.
text_en: Glutathione reductase activity and anti-hydroxyl radical capacity significantly increased with dietary mulberry leaf ethyl ether extract levels up to 4.0 g/kg.

quote: The levels of protein carbonyl were significantly increased under trichlorfon stress
statement: Protein carbonyl levels significantly increased under trichlorfon stress.
text_en: Protein carbonyl levels significantly increased under trichlorfon stress.

quote: the high-density treatment led to a slight decrease in the trypsin activity of the crucian carp hepatopancreas
statement: 高密度处理导致鲫鱼肝胰脏胰蛋白酶活性轻微下降。
text_zh: 高密度处理导致鲫鱼肝胰脏胰蛋白酶活性轻微下降。
text_en: High-density treatment caused a slight decrease in trypsin activity in the hepatopancreas of crucian carp.

quote: The activities of lipase in the hepatopancreas, as well as those of lipase, amylase, Na + /K + -ATPase and alkaline phosphatase in the intestine, were significantly reduced under the high-density treatment (p Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract up to 5.0 and 2.0 g/kg (p Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract (p > 0.05).
statement: 在高密度处理下，肝胰脏脂肪酶以及肠道脂肪酶、淀粉酶、Na+/K+-ATPase和碱性磷酸酶的活性显著降低；桑叶乙醚提取物添加至5.0和2.0 g/kg时（原文此处截断/混乱）。
text_zh: 在高密度处理下，肝胰脏脂肪酶以及肠道脂肪酶、淀粉酶、Na+/K+-ATPase和碱性磷酸酶的活性显著降低；桑叶乙醚提取物添加至5.0和2.0 g/kg时（原文此处截断/混乱）。
text_en: Under high-density treatment, the activities of hepatopancreatic lipase and intestinal lipase, amylase, Na+/K+-ATPase, and alkaline phosphatase significantly decreased; when mulberry leaf ether extract was added at 5.0 and 2.0 g/kg (the original text is truncated/confused here).
intervention: Dietary EML under high density or copper stress
intervention_record: 高密度或铜胁迫下添加EML

quote: The activities of alkaline phosphatase in the intestine slightly increased with the dietary content of the mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract under the high-density treatment.
statement: 在高密度处理下，肠道碱性磷酸酶活性随日粮中桑叶乙醚提取物含量的增加而轻微上升。
text_zh: 在高密度处理下，肠道碱性磷酸酶活性随日粮中桑叶乙醚提取物含量的增加而轻微上升。
text_en: Under high-density treatment, intestinal alkaline phosphatase activity increased slightly with increasing dietary content of mulberry leaf ether extract.
intervention: Dietary EML under high density or copper stress
intervention_record: 高密度或铜胁迫下添加EML

quote: Specifically, the bioenergetic homeostasis and antioxidant status in fish muscles were interrupted by trichlorfon.
statement: 具体而言，鱼肌肉中的生物能量稳态和抗氧化状态被敌百虫中断。
text_zh: 具体而言，鱼肌肉中的生物能量稳态和抗氧化状态被敌百虫中断。
text_en: Specifically, the bioenergetic homeostasis and antioxidant status in fish muscle were disrupted by trichlorfon.

quote: This negative influence was mitigated after dietary EML supplementation at the optimum content of 4.90 g kg/diet, estimated using the IR.
statement: Dietary EML supplementation at 4.90 g/kg diet mitigates the negative influence of trichlorfon on fish.
text_en: Dietary EML supplementation at 4.90 g/kg diet mitigates the negative influence of trichlorfon on fish.

quote: Dietary EML supplementation offers a feasible way of relieving the stress induced by inappropriately high stocking densities, Cu exposure, and trichlorfon exposure.
statement: Dietary EML supplementation is a feasible method to relieve stress caused by high stocking density, copper exposure, and trichlorfon exposure.
text_en: Dietary EML supplementation is a feasible method to relieve stress caused by high stocking density, copper exposure, and trichlorfon exposure.

quote: The anti-hydroxyl radical capacity (indicative of • OH-scavenging capacity) significantly decreased at a high stocking density, and increased after dietary EML supplementation, which indicates that dietary EML reversed the reduction in the • OH-scavenging capacity induced by the inappropriately high stocking density.
statement: 高密度养殖导致抗羟基自由基能力显著下降，而膳食EML补充增加了该能力，表明膳食EML逆转了由不当高密度引起的•OH清除能力的降低。
text_zh: 高密度养殖导致抗羟基自由基能力显著下降，而膳食EML补充增加了该能力，表明膳食EML逆转了由不当高密度引起的•OH清除能力的降低。
text_en: High-density farming caused a significant decrease in hydroxyl radical scavenging capacity, while dietary EML supplementation increased this capacity, indicating that dietary EML reversed the reduction in •OH scavenging capacity caused by inappropriate high density.

quote: Our study is the first to examine the role of EML in mitigating the detrimental effects of excessive • OH free radical production on the digestive organs of fish under high-density conditions.
statement: 本研究首次考察了EML在缓解高密度条件下过量•OH自由基产生对鱼类消化器官有害作用方面的作用。
text_zh: 本研究首次考察了EML在缓解高密度条件下过量•OH自由基产生对鱼类消化器官有害作用方面的作用。
text_en: This study is the first to examine the role of EML in mitigating the harmful effects on fish digestive organs caused by excessive •OH radical production under high-density conditions.
outcome: 消化器官健康/氧化损伤

quote: The activities of CAT decreased in the hepatopancreas under a high stocking density, implying that inappropriately high stocking densities have adverse effects on the antioxidant defense systems of the digestive organs of fish.
statement: 在高密度养殖下，肝胰腺中CAT活性降低，暗示不当的高密度养殖对鱼类消化器官的抗氧化防御系统有不利影响。
text_zh: 在高密度养殖下，肝胰腺中CAT活性降低，暗示不当的高密度养殖对鱼类消化器官的抗氧化防御系统有不利影响。
text_en: Under high-density farming, CAT activity in the hepatopancreas decreased, suggesting that inappropriate high-density farming has adverse effects on the antioxidant defense system of fish digestive organs.

quote: Dietary EML supplementation increased CAT and GPx activities in the digestive organs of fish under high stocking densities.
statement: 在高密度养殖下，膳食EML补充增加了鱼类消化器官中CAT和GPx的活性。
text_zh: 在高密度养殖下，膳食EML补充增加了鱼类消化器官中CAT和GPx的活性。
text_en: Under high-density farming, dietary EML supplementation increased the activity of CAT and GPx in the digestive organs of fish.

quote: In this study, their activities at a high stocking density indicated that the digestive capacity of fish was depressed by the excessively high stocking density.
statement: 本研究中，高放养密度下消化酶活性的测定表明，过高的放养密度抑制了鱼类的消化能力。
text_zh: 本研究中，高放养密度下消化酶活性的测定表明，过高的放养密度抑制了鱼类的消化能力。
text_en: In this study, the measurement of digestive enzyme activity under high stocking density showed that excessively high stocking density inhibited the digestive capacity of fish.

quote: Consistent evidence can be seen in tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) [ 27 ], Liao river shrimp (Palaemonetes sinensis) [ 28 ] and largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) [ 29 ].
statement: 在罗非鱼、辽河沼虾和大口黑鲷中可以看到一致的证据。
text_zh: 在罗非鱼、辽河沼虾和大口黑鲷中可以看到一致的证据。
text_en: Consistent evidence was observed in tilapia, Macrobrachium nipponense, and black porgy.

population.species: 罗非鱼; 辽河沼虾; 大口黑鲷

quote: The decrease in the activities of fish digestive enzymes might be due to the disrupted endocrine system and elevated cortisol levels induced by high stocking densities [ 29 ].
statement: 鱼类消化酶活性的降低可能是由于高放养密度引起的内分泌系统紊乱和皮质醇水平升高所致。
text_zh: 鱼类消化酶活性的降低可能是由于高放养密度引起的内分泌系统紊乱和皮质醇水平升高所致。
text_en: The decrease in fish digestive enzyme activity may be due to endocrine system disruption and elevated cortisol levels caused by high stocking density.
outcome: 内分泌系统与应激激素水平

quote: In the present study, their activities were reduced at a high stocking density, indicating the depressed absorptive capacity of crucian carp under this inappropriately high stocking density.
statement: 在本研究中，高放养密度下碱性磷酸酶和Na+/K+-ATP酶的活性降低，表明在这种不适当的高放养密度下鲫鱼的吸收能力受到抑制。
text_zh: 在本研究中，高放养密度下碱性磷酸酶和Na+/K+-ATP酶的活性降低，表明在这种不适当的高放养密度下鲫鱼的吸收能力受到抑制。
text_en: In this study, the activities of alkaline phosphatase and Na+/K+-ATPase decreased under high stocking density, indicating that the absorption capacity of crucian carp was inhibited under this inappropriate high stocking density.

quote: In rainbow trout, high stocking densities have been found to decrease the expression of genes related to the function and integrity of the intestinal epithelium [ 30 ].
statement: 在虹鳟中，已发现高放养密度会降低与肠上皮功能和完整性相关的基因表达。
text_zh: 在虹鳟中，已发现高放养密度会降低与肠上皮功能和完整性相关的基因表达。
text_en: In rainbow trout, high stocking density has been found to reduce the expression of genes related to intestinal epithelial function and integrity.
outcome: 肠道上皮功能与完整性

quote: Trichlorfon exposure increased the number of ROS in fish, resulting in protein oxidation and lipid peroxidation
statement: 敌百虫暴露增加了鱼体内的活性氧数量，导致蛋白质氧化和脂质过氧化。
text_zh: 敌百虫暴露增加了鱼体内的活性氧数量，导致蛋白质氧化和脂质过氧化。
text_en: Trichlorfon exposure increased the number of reactive oxygen species in fish, leading to protein oxidation and lipid peroxidation.

quote: Our present study showed that the contents of protein carbonyl were significantly higher in crucian carp muscles under trichlorfon exposure, contributing to protein oxidation.
statement: 本研究表明，在敌百虫暴露下，鲫鱼肌肉中的蛋白质羰基含量显著升高，促进了蛋白质氧化。
text_zh: 本研究表明，在敌百虫暴露下，鲫鱼肌肉中的蛋白质羰基含量显著升高，促进了蛋白质氧化。
text_en: This study shows that under trichlorfon exposure, protein carbonyl content in crucian carp muscle increased significantly, promoting protein oxidation.

quote: In the present study, dietary EML supplementation decreased the values of these parameters, indicating that it weakened the trichlorfon-induced damage.
statement: 在本研究中，膳食补充桑叶提取物降低了这些参数的数值，表明它减弱了敌百虫诱导的损伤。
text_zh: 在本研究中，膳食补充桑叶提取物降低了这些参数的数值，表明它减弱了敌百虫诱导的损伤。
text_en: In this study, dietary supplementation with mulberry leaf extract (EML) reduced the values of these parameters, indicating that it attenuated trichlorfon-induced damage.
outcome: 缓解敌百虫诱导的组织损伤

quote: In the present study, the anti-superoxide anion capacity (indicative of O 2 •− -scavenging capacity) and anti-hydroxyl radical capacity decreased under trichlorfon exposure, and was elevated after dietary EML supplementation, which indicates that dietary EML protects against the detrimental effect of excessive free radical production caused by trichlorfon.
statement: 在本研究中，敌百虫暴露下抗超氧阴离子能力和抗羟基自由基能力下降，而在膳食补充桑叶提取物后升高，这表明膳食桑叶提取物能保护鱼类免受敌百虫引起的过量自由基产生的有害影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，敌百虫暴露下抗超氧阴离子能力和抗羟基自由基能力下降，而在膳食补充桑叶提取物后升高，这表明膳食桑叶提取物能保护鱼类免受敌百虫引起的过量自由基产生的有害影响。
text_en: In this study, anti-superoxide anion and anti-hydroxyl radical capacities decreased under trichlorfon exposure but increased after dietary supplementation with mulberry leaf extract, indicating that dietary mulberry leaf extract protects fish from the harmful effects of excessive free radical production caused by trichlorfon.

quote: In the present study, the MDA content was significantly higher in the hepatopancreas and intestine of crucian carp reared at a high stocking density, which indicates that the inappropriately high stocking density caused lipid peroxidation in their digestive organs.
statement: 本研究发现，高密度养殖的鲫鱼肝胰腺和肠道中的MDA含量显著升高，表明不适当的高密度养殖导致其消化器官发生脂质过氧化。
text_zh: 本研究发现，高密度养殖的鲫鱼肝胰腺和肠道中的MDA含量显著升高，表明不适当的高密度养殖导致其消化器官发生脂质过氧化。
text_en: This study found that MDA content in the hepatopancreas and intestine of crucian carp under high-density farming was significantly increased, indicating that inappropriate high-density farming caused lipid peroxidation in their digestive organs.
outcome: 氧化应激与脂质过氧化

quote: The study on largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) showed a consistent result, with high stocking densities negatively effecting the liver MDA content [ 29 ].
statement: 大口黑鲷的研究显示了一致的结果，即高密度养殖对肝脏MDA含量产生负面影响。
text_zh: 大口黑鲷的研究显示了一致的结果，即高密度养殖对肝脏MDA含量产生负面影响。
text_en: Research on largemouth bass showed consistent results that high-density farming has a negative effect on liver MDA content.
outcome: 氧化应激与脂质过氧化

quote: In the present study, the MDA content significantly increased at a high stocking density, and decreased after EML supplementation, which shows that dietary EML diminishes the negative influence of an excessively high stocking density on lipid peroxidation.
statement: 本研究中，高密度下MDA含量显著增加，而在补充EML后降低，这表明膳食EML减轻了过高密度养殖对脂质过氧化的负面影响。
text_zh: 本研究中，高密度下MDA含量显著增加，而在补充EML后降低，这表明膳食EML减轻了过高密度养殖对脂质过氧化的负面影响。
text_en: In this study, MDA content increased significantly under high density, but decreased after EML supplementation, indicating that dietary EML alleviated the negative effects of over-dense farming on lipid peroxidation.
outcome: 氧化应激与脂质过氧化

quote: These results conformed to our laboratory report stating that the increase in the MDA content induced by hypoxia/reoxygenation in the intestine and hepatopancreas was suppressed by dietary EML supplementation in crucian carp [ 12 ].
statement: 这些结果符合我们实验室的报告，即膳食EML补充抑制了缺氧/复氧诱导的鲫鱼肠道和肝胰腺中MDA含量的增加。
text_zh: 这些结果符合我们实验室的报告，即膳食EML补充抑制了缺氧/复氧诱导的鲫鱼肠道和肝胰腺中MDA含量的增加。
text_en: These results are consistent with our laboratory's report that dietary EML supplementation inhibited the increase in MDA content in the intestine and hepatopancreas of crucian carp induced by hypoxia/reoxygenation.
outcome: 氧化应激与脂质过氧化

quote: Flavonoids, an active ingredient of mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf extract, inhibited MDA formation in rat liver [ 37 ]. They might have a favorable effect on preventing lipid peroxidation in the digestive organs of fish, which needs further investigation.
statement: 桑叶提取物中的活性成分类黄酮在大鼠肝脏中抑制了MDA的形成；它们可能对预防鱼类消化器官的脂质过氧化具有有利作用，但这需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 桑叶提取物中的活性成分类黄酮在大鼠肝脏中抑制了MDA的形成；它们可能对预防鱼类消化器官的脂质过氧化具有有利作用，但这需要进一步研究。
text_en: The active ingredient flavonoids in mulberry leaf extract inhibited MDA formation in rat liver; they may have a beneficial effect on preventing lipid peroxidation in the digestive organs of fish, but this requires further research.
outcome: 氧化应激与脂质过氧化

quote: The present study showed that GOT and GPT activities increased under Cu exposure, which indicates that the protein and amino acid metabolism were activated by Cu stress.
statement: 本研究表明，在铜暴露下GOT和GPT活性增加，这表明蛋白质和氨基酸代谢被铜胁迫激活。
text_zh: 本研究表明，在铜暴露下GOT和GPT活性增加，这表明蛋白质和氨基酸代谢被铜胁迫激活。
text_en: This study shows that GOT and GPT activities increased under copper exposure, indicating that protein and amino acid metabolism was activated by copper stress.
outcome: 氨基酸代谢与应激反应

quote: Parallel findings were documented in sculpin (Myoxocephalus octodecemspinosus), with Cu exposure elevating plasma ammonia [ 33 ].
statement: 在杜父鱼（Myoxocephalus octodecemspinosus）中记录了类似的发现，铜暴露导致血浆氨升高。
text_zh: 在杜父鱼（Myoxocephalus octodecemspinosus）中记录了类似的发现，铜暴露导致血浆氨升高。
text_en: Similar findings were recorded in sculpin (Myoxocephalus octodecemspinosus), where copper exposure led to elevated plasma ammonia.

quote: In teleost, the increase in plasma ammonia is most likely due to the increased protein and amino acid breakdown rate arising from elevated cortisol levels under Cu exposure [ 34 ].
statement: 在硬骨鱼中，血浆氨的增加最可能是由于铜暴露下皮质醇水平升高导致的蛋白质和氨基酸分解率增加。
text_zh: 在硬骨鱼中，血浆氨的增加最可能是由于铜暴露下皮质醇水平升高导致的蛋白质和氨基酸分解率增加。
text_en: In teleost fish, the increase in plasma ammonia is most likely due to increased protein and amino acid breakdown rates caused by elevated cortisol levels under copper exposure.
outcome: 皮质醇水平与蛋白质分解

quote: In the present study, dietary EML supplementation decreased GOT and GPT activities under Cu exposure, which indicates that it weakened the detrimental effect of Cu exposure on the amino acid metabolism of fish.
statement: 在本研究中，日粮补充EML降低了铜暴露下的GOT和GPT活性，这表明它减弱了铜暴露对鱼类氨基酸代谢的不利影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，日粮补充EML降低了铜暴露下的GOT和GPT活性，这表明它减弱了铜暴露对鱼类氨基酸代谢的不利影响。
text_en: In this study, dietary EML supplementation reduced GOT and GPT activities under copper exposure, indicating that it mitigated the adverse effects of copper exposure on amino acid metabolism in fish.

quote: Notably, no other reports focused on the relationship between EML and amino acid metabolism in fish under Cu stress.
statement: 值得注意的是，没有其他报告关注铜胁迫下EML与鱼类氨基酸代谢之间的关系。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，没有其他报告关注铜胁迫下EML与鱼类氨基酸代谢之间的关系。
text_en: It is worth noting that no other reports have focused on the relationship between EML and fish amino acid metabolism under copper stress.

quote: Our study showed that the activities of trypsin, lipase, amylase and alkaline phosphatase in the digestive organs decreased under CuSO 4 exposure, which suggests that the digestive and adsorptive capacities of crucian carp were depressed when they were treated with CuSO 4 .
statement: 硫酸铜暴露导致鲫鱼消化器官中胰蛋白酶、脂肪酶、淀粉酶和碱性磷酸酶的活性降低，表明其消化和吸收能力受到抑制。
text_zh: 硫酸铜暴露导致鲫鱼消化器官中胰蛋白酶、脂肪酶、淀粉酶和碱性磷酸酶的活性降低，表明其消化和吸收能力受到抑制。
text_en: Copper sulfate exposure led to decreased activities of trypsin, lipase, amylase, and alkaline phosphatase in the digestive organs of crucian carp, indicating that their digestion and absorption capacity was inhibited.

quote: Similar observations have been reported in juvenile Epinephelus coioides , with Cu exposure being found to hinder the activities of digestive enzymes, including protease, lipase and amylase in the liver and intestine [ 31 ].
statement: 在幼鱼Epinephelus coioides中也观察到类似现象，铜暴露阻碍了肝脏和肠道中蛋白酶、脂肪酶和淀粉酶等消化酶的活性。
text_zh: 在幼鱼Epinephelus coioides中也观察到类似现象，铜暴露阻碍了肝脏和肠道中蛋白酶、脂肪酶和淀粉酶等消化酶的活性。
text_en: A similar phenomenon was also observed in juvenile Epinephelus coioides, where copper exposure inhibited the activity of digestive enzymes such as protease, lipase, and amylase in the liver and intestine.

quote: The decrease in the activities of fish digestive enzymes possibly arose from the deposition of metal granules in the fish liver and the provocation of hepatic DNA damage [ 32 ].
statement: 鱼类消化酶活性的降低可能源于金属颗粒在鱼肝中的沉积以及由此引发的肝脏DNA损伤。
text_zh: 鱼类消化酶活性的降低可能源于金属颗粒在鱼肝中的沉积以及由此引发的肝脏DNA损伤。
text_en: The decrease in fish digestive enzyme activity may stem from the deposition of metal particles in the fish liver and the resulting liver DNA damage.

quote: In the present study, dietary EML supplementation increased the activities of trypsin, amylase, lipase, Na + /K + -ATPase and alkaline phosphatase, which indicates that it protects against the negative effects exerted by the inappropriately high stocking density and Cu exposure on the digestive and absorptive capacities of fish.
statement: 在本研究中，日粮添加EML提高了胰蛋白酶、淀粉酶、脂肪酶、Na+/K+-ATPase和碱性磷酸酶的活性，表明它能保护鱼类免受不当高放养密度和铜暴露对消化吸收能力的负面影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，日粮添加EML提高了胰蛋白酶、淀粉酶、脂肪酶、Na+/K+-ATPase和碱性磷酸酶的活性，表明它能保护鱼类免受不当高放养密度和铜暴露对消化吸收能力的负面影响。
text_en: In this study, dietary EML supplementation increased the activities of trypsin, amylase, lipase, Na+/K+-ATPase and alkaline phosphatase, indicating that it can protect fish from the negative effects of inappropriate high stocking density and copper exposure on digestive and absorptive capacity.

quote: These results conformed to our laboratory report finding that dietary EML supplementation improved the digestive and absorptive capacities of crucian carp [ 12 ].
statement: 这些结果符合我们实验室之前的报告，即日粮添加EML改善了鲫鱼的消化和吸收能力。
text_zh: 这些结果符合我们实验室之前的报告，即日粮添加EML改善了鲫鱼的消化和吸收能力。
text_en: These results are consistent with our laboratory's previous reports, namely that dietary EML supplementation improved the digestion and absorption capacity of crucian carp.

quote: To the best of our knowledge, our study was the first to propose that EML relieved the detrimental effects on the digestive capacity of fish under high stocking and Cu stress.
statement: 据我们所知，本研究首次提出EML缓解了高放养密度和铜胁迫下对鱼类消化能力的有害影响。
text_zh: 据我们所知，本研究首次提出EML缓解了高放养密度和铜胁迫下对鱼类消化能力的有害影响。
text_en: To our knowledge, this study is the first to propose that EML alleviated the harmful effects on fish digestive capacity under high stocking density and copper stress.

quote: The activities of amylase in the hepatopancreas, as well as those of trypsin, amylase and alkaline phosphatase in the intestine, were significantly reduced... under Cu exposure
statement: 在铜暴露下，肝胰腺淀粉酶以及肠道胰蛋白酶、淀粉酶和碱性磷酸酶的活性显著降低。
text_zh: 在铜暴露下，肝胰腺淀粉酶以及肠道胰蛋白酶、淀粉酶和碱性磷酸酶的活性显著降低。
text_en: Under copper exposure, the activities of hepatopancreatic amylase and intestinal trypsin, amylase, and alkaline phosphatase were significantly reduced.

quote: the activities of glutamate–pyruvate transaminase and glutamate–oxaloacetate transaminase in the hepatopancreas were significantly increased under Cu exposure
statement: 在铜暴露下，肝胰腺谷丙转氨酶和谷草转氨酶的活性显著增加。
text_zh: 在铜暴露下，肝胰腺谷丙转氨酶和谷草转氨酶的活性显著增加。
text_en: Under copper exposure, the activities of alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase in the hepatopancreas increased significantly.
outcome: 代谢酶活性/肝功能指标

quote: The activities of glutamate–pyruvate transaminase and glutamate–oxaloacetate transaminase decreased with the increase in the dietary levels of the mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf ethyl ether extract up to 5.0 g/kg.
statement: 随着日粮中桑叶乙醚提取物水平增加到5.0 g/kg，谷丙转氨酶和谷草转氨酶的活性降低。
text_zh: 随着日粮中桑叶乙醚提取物水平增加到5.0 g/kg，谷丙转氨酶和谷草转氨酶的活性降低。
text_en: As the level of mulberry leaf ether extract in the diet increased to 5.0 g/kg, the activities of alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase decreased.
outcome: 代谢酶活性/肝功能指标

quote: rollover was significantly increased under trichlorfon stress
statement: 在敌百虫胁迫下，翻肚现象显著增加。
text_zh: 在敌百虫胁迫下，翻肚现象显著增加。
text_en: Under trichlorfon stress, the rolling-over phenomenon increased significantly.

quote: These results matched our laboratory outcome, with dietary EML enhancing the antioxidant enzymes’ defense systems in the intestine and hepatopancreas of the crucian carp [ 12 ].
statement: 这些结果与实验室研究一致，即日粮EML增强了鲫鱼肠道和肝胰腺中抗氧化酶的防御系统。
text_zh: 这些结果与实验室研究一致，即日粮EML增强了鲫鱼肠道和肝胰腺中抗氧化酶的防御系统。
text_en: These results are consistent with laboratory studies showing that dietary EML enhanced the antioxidant enzyme defense system in the intestine and hepatopancreas of crucian carp.

quote: Quercetin, a kind of flavonol glycoside in mulberry leaves, reduced oxidative stress in the liver of mice [ 40 ]. We anticipate a similar effect in the case of the digestive organs of fish, which needs further investigation.
statement: 桑叶中的一种黄酮醇糖苷槲皮素降低了小鼠肝脏的氧化应激，作者预期在鱼类消化器官中也有类似效果，但这需要进一步调查。
text_zh: 桑叶中的一种黄酮醇糖苷槲皮素降低了小鼠肝脏的氧化应激，作者预期在鱼类消化器官中也有类似效果，但这需要进一步调查。
text_en: Quercetin, a flavonol glycoside in mulberry leaves, reduced oxidative stress in the livers of mice; the authors expected a similar effect in the digestive organs of fish, but this requires further investigation.

quote: Trichlorfon makes the fish lose their balance by inhibiting acetylcholinesterase (AChE) activity at the neuromuscular junctions of fish muscle [ 9 ].
statement: 敌百虫通过抑制鱼肌肉神经肌肉接头处的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）活性使鱼失去平衡。
text_zh: 敌百虫通过抑制鱼肌肉神经肌肉接头处的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）活性使鱼失去平衡。
text_en: Trichlorfon causes fish to lose balance by inhibiting acetylcholinesterase (AChE) activity at the neuromuscular junction of fish muscle.
outcome: 平衡能力/神经肌肉功能

quote: In the present study, trichlorfon induced significant detrimental effects, as indicated by crucian carp rollover. These phenomena were relieved by dietary EML supplementation, which reveals that dietary EML alleviated the detrimental effects of trichlorfon.
statement: 在本研究中，敌百虫诱导了显著的有害影响，表现为鲫鱼翻滚；日粮EML补充缓解了这些现象，表明日粮EML减轻了敌百虫的有害影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，敌百虫诱导了显著的有害影响，表现为鲫鱼翻滚；日粮EML补充缓解了这些现象，表明日粮EML减轻了敌百虫的有害影响。
text_en: In this study, trichlorfon induced significant harmful effects, manifested as rolling in crucian carp; dietary EML supplementation alleviated these phenomena, indicating that dietary EML mitigated the harmful effects of trichlorfon.

quote: Maintaining these fish always with vigor and intense color until they reach the final consumer has been one of the main obstacles faced by the ornamental fish producer due to the handling and harvesting processes, as the fish go through periods of stress, which can cause the decrease of this vigor referring to the color of these fish (Nascimento et al. 2019).
statement: 由于处理和捕捞过程导致鱼类经历应激期，从而引起活力和颜色下降，这一直是观赏鱼生产者面临的主要障碍之一。
text_zh: 由于处理和捕捞过程导致鱼类经历应激期，从而引起活力和颜色下降，这一直是观赏鱼生产者面临的主要障碍之一。
text_en: The stress period experienced by fish due to handling and harvesting processes, which causes a decline in vitality and color, has been one of the major obstacles faced by ornamental fish producers.

quote: Our study was the first to reveal that EML relieved the detrimental effect of excessive free radical production in fish muscles under trichlorfon exposure.
statement: 本研究首次揭示在敌百虫暴露下，EML缓解了鱼肌肉中过量自由基产生的有害影响。
text_zh: 本研究首次揭示在敌百虫暴露下，EML缓解了鱼肌肉中过量自由基产生的有害影响。
text_en: This study is the first to reveal that EML mitigated the harmful effects of excessive free radical production in fish muscle under exposure to trichlorfon.

quote: In this study, CAT and GR activities were significantly lower in crucian carp muscles exposed to trichlorfon, which indicates that the fish enzymatic antioxidant defense systems were disturbed by trichlorfon exposure.
statement: 本研究中，暴露于敌百虫的鲫鱼肌肉中CAT和GR活性显著降低，表明鱼的酶促抗氧化防御系统受到敌百虫暴露的干扰。
text_zh: 本研究中，暴露于敌百虫的鲫鱼肌肉中CAT和GR活性显著降低，表明鱼的酶促抗氧化防御系统受到敌百虫暴露的干扰。
text_en: In this study, the activities of CAT and GR in the muscle of crucian carp exposed to trichlorfon were significantly reduced, indicating that the enzymatic antioxidant defense system of the fish was disrupted by trichlorfon exposure.
outcome: 酶促抗氧化防御系统功能

quote: Similarly, it has been reported that trichlorfon exposure decreases CAT activities in the gills and livers of common carp (Cyprinus carpio L.) [ 45 ].
statement: 据报道，敌百虫暴露会降低鲤鱼鳃和肝脏中的CAT活性。
text_zh: 据报道，敌百虫暴露会降低鲤鱼鳃和肝脏中的CAT活性。
text_en: It is reported that trichlorfon exposure reduces CAT activity in the gills and liver of carp.
outcome: 鳃和肝脏抗氧化酶活性

quote: The decrease in antioxidant enzyme activities may be due to the excessive free radical production induced by trichlorfon.
statement: 抗氧化酶活性的下降可能是由于敌百虫诱导的过量自由基产生所致。
text_zh: 抗氧化酶活性的下降可能是由于敌百虫诱导的过量自由基产生所致。
text_en: The decrease in antioxidant enzyme activity may be due to excessive free radical production induced by trichlorfon.

quote: In the present study, dietary EML supplementation increased the activities of these enzymes, suggesting that it protects against the detrimental effect of the trichlorfon-induced imbalance between oxidants and antioxidants.
statement: 在本研究中，膳食EML补充增加了这些酶的活性，表明它保护了免受敌百虫诱导的氧化剂与抗氧化剂失衡的有害影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，膳食EML补充增加了这些酶的活性，表明它保护了免受敌百虫诱导的氧化剂与抗氧化剂失衡的有害影响。
text_en: In this study, dietary EML supplementation increased the activity of these enzymes, indicating that it protected against the harmful effects of trichlorfon-induced oxidant-antioxidant imbalance.

quote: Results obtained showed that there was a significant difference about feed intake and specific growth rate with the inclusion of JPF.
statement: 研究结果显示，添加Jabuticaba果皮粉（JPF）对摄食量和特定生长率有显著影响。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，添加Jabuticaba果皮粉（JPF）对摄食量和特定生长率有显著影响。
text_en: The results showed that the addition of Jabuticaba peel powder (JPF) had a significant effect on feed intake and specific growth rate.

quote: AST activity was higher with 1.00% JPF and ALT was reduced with the inclusion of JPF, demonstrating an ability to protect against possible liver damage.
statement: 1.00% JPF处理组的天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性较高，而添加JPF后丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）降低，表明其具有保护肝脏免受潜在损伤的能力。
text_zh: 1.00% JPF处理组的天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性较高，而添加JPF后丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）降低，表明其具有保护肝脏免受潜在损伤的能力。
text_en: The aspartate aminotransferase (AST) activity was higher in the 1.00% JPF treatment group, while alanine aminotransferase (ALT) decreased after adding JPF, indicating its ability to protect the liver from potential damage.

quote: Those used in fish feeding consisted of diets with the addition of jabuticaba peel flour (control – without the addition of JPF; 1.00; 1.50 and 2.00%) in a completely randomized design with four treatments and three replications in a system of water recirculation.
statement: 实验使用添加不同比例（0%、1.00%、1.50%和2.00%）的嘉宝果果皮粉饲料，在循环水系统中对鱼进行喂养。
text_zh: 实验使用添加不同比例（0%、1.00%、1.50%和2.00%）的嘉宝果果皮粉饲料，在循环水系统中对鱼进行喂养。
text_en: The experiment fed fish in a recirculating aquaculture system with diets containing different proportions (0%, 1.00%, 1.50%, and 2.00%) of jabuticaba peel powder.

quote: Fish were fed twice a day at a rate of approximately 10% of live weight.
statement: 鱼每天喂食两次，投喂量约为活体重量的10%。
text_zh: 鱼每天喂食两次，投喂量约为活体重量的10%。
text_en: Fish are fed twice a day, with the feeding amount being about 10% of their live body weight.
intervention: Feeding twice daily at 10% body weight

quote: After 60 days, the data related to growth performance (body weight and length) were measured: Weight gain = final weight-initial weight; SGR = ((ln of final weight - ln of initial weight) × 100) /days of experiment; FC = feed intake / gain in weight; Survival = (final number of fish / initial number of fish) × 100.
statement: 60天后测量了与生长性能相关的数据，包括增重、特定生长率、饲料系数和存活率。
text_zh: 60天后测量了与生长性能相关的数据，包括增重、特定生长率、饲料系数和存活率。
text_en: Data related to growth performance, including weight gain, specific growth rate, feed conversion ratio, and survival rate, were measured after 60 days.

quote: The use of bioactive substances has received increasing attention due to increased feed palatability followed by increased growth (Takoaka et al. 2011) and an improvement indigestive enzyme activity (Rashidian et al. 2020) and, along with other compounds act to maintain and intensification of the skin color of these animals (Lopes et al. 2007).
statement: Bioactive substances increase feed palatability and growth, improve digestive enzyme activity, and help maintain or intensify skin color.
text_en: Bioactive substances increase feed palatability and growth, improve digestive enzyme activity, and help maintain or intensify skin color.
intervention: Diets with bioactive substances from by-products
intervention_record: 副产物生物活性物质日粮

quote: In this context, there is a demand for specific diets for ornamental fish, which can use bioactive substances that keep them colorful and showy, generating a growing interest in research aimed at the use of these substances, which can be extracted from foods and their by-products (shell, seeds and bagasse) from the Brazilian fauna, which can be incorporated into other foods and effectively improve the nutritional value added and improve the quality of life of fish (Aziz et al. 2012 ; Morales et al. 2016).
statement: Specific diets using bioactive substances extracted from food by-products can improve the nutritional value and quality of life of ornamental fish while keeping them colorful.
text_en: Specific diets using bioactive substances extracted from food by-products can improve the nutritional value and quality of life of ornamental fish while keeping them colorful.
intervention: Diets with bioactive substances from by-products
intervention_record: 副产物生物活性物质日粮

quote: In the present study, LDH activity was significantly lower in crucian carp muscles exposed to trichlorfon, contributing to an energetic imbalance.
statement: 本研究中，暴露于敌百虫的鲫鱼肌肉中LDH活性显著降低，导致能量失衡。
text_zh: 本研究中，暴露于敌百虫的鲫鱼肌肉中LDH活性显著降低，导致能量失衡。
text_en: In this study, LDH activity in the muscle of crucian carp exposed to trichlorfon was significantly reduced, leading to energy imbalance.

quote: It is apparent that trichlorfon exposure altered the bioenergetic homeostasis by inhibiting the activity of creatine kinase, which is an important enzyme for energy homeostasis and the activation of complexes II–III and IV of the respiratory chain (a crucial pathway for ATP production) [ 43 ].
statement: 显然，敌百虫暴露通过抑制肌酸激酶活性改变了生物能量稳态，肌酸激酶是能量稳态和呼吸链复合物II-IV激活的重要酶。
text_zh: 显然，敌百虫暴露通过抑制肌酸激酶活性改变了生物能量稳态，肌酸激酶是能量稳态和呼吸链复合物II-IV激活的重要酶。
text_en: Clearly, trichlorfon exposure altered bioenergetic homeostasis by inhibiting creatine kinase activity, an important enzyme for energy homeostasis and the activation of respiratory chain complexes II-IV.

quote: GOT and GPT activities were also significantly lower in crucian carp muscles exposed to trichlorfon, contributing to an energetic imbalance.
statement: 暴露于敌百虫的鲫鱼肌肉中GOT和GPT活性也显著降低，导致能量失衡。
text_zh: 暴露于敌百虫的鲫鱼肌肉中GOT和GPT活性也显著降低，导致能量失衡。
text_en: Exposure to trichlorfon significantly reduced GOT and GPT activities in the muscle of crucian carp, leading to energy imbalance.

quote: Under stressful conditions, such as exposure to pesticides, lipids are used as alternative energy sources in fish muscles, corroborating the alteration in the fatty acid profiles of silver catfish in the presence of trichlorfon [ 43 ].
statement: 在应激条件下，如暴露于农药时，脂质被用作鱼类肌肉中的替代能源，这证实了存在敌百虫时银鲶脂肪酸谱的改变。
text_zh: 在应激条件下，如暴露于农药时，脂质被用作鱼类肌肉中的替代能源，这证实了存在敌百虫时银鲶脂肪酸谱的改变。
text_en: Under stress conditions, such as exposure to pesticides, lipids are used as an alternative energy source in fish muscle, which confirms the alteration of the fatty acid profile of silver catfish in the presence of trichlorfon.

quote: In this study, the activities of GPT, LDH and GOT decreased in crucian carp muscles under trichlorfon exposure, and increased after dietary EML supplementation, which demonstrates that dietary EML protects against the inhibitory effect of trichlorfon on fish bioenergetic homeostasis.
statement: 在本研究中，敌百虫暴露下鲫鱼肌肉中GPT、LDH和GOT活性降低，而在膳食补充EML后增加，这表明膳食EML保护鱼类免受敌百虫对生物能量稳态的抑制作用。
text_zh: 在本研究中，敌百虫暴露下鲫鱼肌肉中GPT、LDH和GOT活性降低，而在膳食补充EML后增加，这表明膳食EML保护鱼类免受敌百虫对生物能量稳态的抑制作用。
text_en: In this study, the activities of GPT, LDH and GOT in the muscle of crucian carp decreased under trichlorfon exposure, but increased after dietary supplementation with EML, indicating that dietary EML protects fish from the inhibitory effect of trichlorfon on bioenergetic homeostasis.

quote: This may partly explain the trichlorfon-induced rollover of crucian carp.
statement: 这可能部分解释了敌百虫诱导的鲫鱼翻滚现象。
text_zh: 这可能部分解释了敌百虫诱导的鲫鱼翻滚现象。
text_en: This may partly explain the trichlorfon-induced rolling phenomenon in crucian carp.

quote: Nevertheless, the mechanism by which EML relieved the trichlorfon-induced muscle dysfunction in fish needs further exploration.
statement: 然而，EML缓解鱼类敌百虫诱导的肌肉功能障碍的机制需要进一步探索。
text_zh: 然而，EML缓解鱼类敌百虫诱导的肌肉功能障碍的机制需要进一步探索。
text_en: However, the mechanism by which EML alleviates trichlorfon-induced muscle dysfunction in fish requires further exploration.

quote: In addition, the use of nutritional additives that have bioactive promoting health and well-being benefits, in addition to intensifying the skin color fish (Eaton et al. 2016) and in the hepatoprotective action (Leite et al. 2011).
statement: Nutritional additives with bioactive properties promote health and well-being, intensify fish skin color, and have hepatoprotective action.
text_en: Nutritional additives with bioactive properties promote health and well-being, intensify fish skin color, and have hepatoprotective action.

quote: ory report demonstrating that the dietary supplementation of mulberry (Morus alba L.) leaf extracts (EML) enhances the growth performance of crucian carp [ 12 ].
statement: 已有报告表明，桑叶提取物（EML）的膳食补充能增强鲫鱼的生长性能。
text_zh: 已有报告表明，桑叶提取物（EML）的膳食补充能增强鲫鱼的生长性能。
text_en: It has been reported that dietary supplementation with mulberry leaf extract (EML) can enhance the growth performance of crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, broken-line analysis was performed to determine the optimum amount of dietary EML supplementation under the high stocking density, and based on the recovery rate of weight gain (RWG), the value was estimated to be 4.85 g kg/diet.
statement: 本研究通过折线分析确定在高密度养殖条件下膳食EML补充的最佳量，基于体重增加恢复率（RWG），估计值为4.85 g/kg饲料。
text_zh: 本研究通过折线分析确定在高密度养殖条件下膳食EML补充的最佳量，基于体重增加恢复率（RWG），估计值为4.85 g/kg饲料。
text_en: This study determined the optimal dietary EML supplementation level under high-density farming conditions through breakpoint analysis, estimated at 4.85 g/kg feed based on relative weight gain recovery (RWG).
intervention: Dietary EML under high density or copper stress
intervention_record: 高密度或铜胁迫下添加EML

quote: In the fish farming industry, the water quality and infections are commonly controlled by copper sulfate [ 5 ].
statement: 在水产养殖业中，水质和感染通常通过硫酸铜控制。
text_zh: 在水产养殖业中，水质和感染通常通过硫酸铜控制。
text_en: In aquaculture, water quality and infections are usually controlled by copper sulfate.

quote: In the present study, copper had significant detrimental effects on crucian carp, as indicated by their reduced feed intake.
statement: 本研究中，铜对鲫鱼有显著的有害影响，表现为摄食量减少。
text_zh: 本研究中，铜对鲫鱼有显著的有害影响，表现为摄食量减少。
text_en: In this study, copper had a significant harmful effect on crucian carp, manifested as reduced feed intake.

quote: Consistent with our present results, a study on Indian Major Carp (Cirrhinus mrigala) showed that the feed intake reduced significantly in all Cu treatment groups [ 24 ].
statement: 与我们目前的结果一致，一项关于印度主要鲤鱼（Cirrhinus mrigala）的研究显示，所有铜处理组的摄食量均显著减少。
text_zh: 与我们目前的结果一致，一项关于印度主要鲤鱼（Cirrhinus mrigala）的研究显示，所有铜处理组的摄食量均显著减少。
text_en: Consistent with our current results, a study on Indian major carp (Cirrhinus mrigala) showed that feed intake was significantly reduced in all copper treatment groups.

quote: In addition, copper increased crucian carp mortality [ 19 ].
statement: 此外，铜增加了鲫鱼的死亡率。
text_zh: 此外，铜增加了鲫鱼的死亡率。
text_en: In addition, copper increased the mortality of crucian carp.

quote: Similar observations were obtained in Cirrhinus mrigala [ 24 ] and Caspian Sea kutum (Rutilus frisii kutum) [ 23 ].
statement: 在Cirrhinus mrigala和里海库图姆鱼（Rutilus frisii kutum）中也获得了类似的观察结果。
text_zh: 在Cirrhinus mrigala和里海库图姆鱼（Rutilus frisii kutum）中也获得了类似的观察结果。
text_en: Similar observations were also obtained in Cirrhinus mrigala and Caspian kutum (Rutilus frisii kutum).

quote: In the present study, the feed intake was significantly decreased by CuSO 4 , and was increased by dietary EML supplementation, indicating that dietary EML alleviated the detrimental effect of Cu stress.
statement: 本研究中，CuSO4显著降低了摄食量，而膳食EML补充增加了摄食量，表明膳食EML缓解了铜胁迫的有害影响。
text_zh: 本研究中，CuSO4显著降低了摄食量，而膳食EML补充增加了摄食量，表明膳食EML缓解了铜胁迫的有害影响。
text_en: In this study, CuSO4 significantly reduced feed intake, while dietary EML supplementation increased feed intake, indicating that dietary EML alleviated the harmful effects of copper stress.
intervention: Dietary EML under high density or copper stress
intervention_record: 高密度或铜胁迫下添加EML

quote: In the broken-line analysis, the optimum amount of dietary EML supplementation under Cu exposure was 4.52 g kg/diet based on the rate of feed intake (RFI) for crucian carp.
statement: 在折线分析中，基于鲫鱼的摄食率（RFI），铜暴露下膳食EML补充的最佳量为4.52 g/kg饲料。
text_zh: 在折线分析中，基于鲫鱼的摄食率（RFI），铜暴露下膳食EML补充的最佳量为4.52 g/kg饲料。
text_en: In the broken-line analysis, based on the feed intake rate (RFI) of crucian carp, the optimal dietary EML supplementation under copper exposure is 4.52 g/kg feed.
intervention: Dietary EML under high density or copper stress
intervention_record: 高密度或铜胁迫下添加EML

quote: Carassius auratus fed with jabuticaba peel flour will have better growth and greater skin luminosity without negatively affecting liver function.
statement: Feed containing jabuticaba peel flour improves growth and skin luminosity in Carassius auratus without negatively affecting liver function.
text_en: Feed containing jabuticaba peel flour improves growth and skin luminosity in Carassius auratus without negatively affecting liver function.

quote: There was no mortality in the treatments tested.
statement: 在测试的处理组中没有发生死亡。
text_zh: 在测试的处理组中没有发生死亡。
text_en: No deaths occurred in the tested treatment groups.

quote: Under the inappropriately high stocking density, fish growth was depressed, their digestive and absorptive capacities were degraded, and their antioxidant status was interrupted.
statement: 不适当的高放养密度导致鱼类生长受抑、消化吸收能力下降以及抗氧化状态中断。
text_zh: 不适当的高放养密度导致鱼类生长受抑、消化吸收能力下降以及抗氧化状态中断。
text_en: Inappropriately high stocking density leads to inhibited fish growth, decreased digestion and absorption capacity, and disrupted antioxidant status.

quote: These parameters were improved after the dietary EML supplementation, indicating that it relieved the detrimental effect of a high stocking density on fish growth performance.
statement: 膳食EML补充剂改善了上述参数，表明其缓解了高放养密度对鱼类生长性能的有害影响。
text_zh: 膳食EML补充剂改善了上述参数，表明其缓解了高放养密度对鱼类生长性能的有害影响。
text_en: Dietary EML supplementation improved the above parameters, indicating that it alleviated the harmful effects of high stocking density on fish growth performance.

quote: In the broken-line analysis, the optimum amount of dietary EML supplementation was estimated as 4.85 g kg/diet according to the RWG of crucian carp under the high stocking density.
statement: 根据高放养密度下鲫鱼的相对增重率（RWG），折线分析估计最佳膳食EML添加量为4.85 g/kg饲料。
text_zh: 根据高放养密度下鲫鱼的相对增重率（RWG），折线分析估计最佳膳食EML添加量为4.85 g/kg饲料。
text_en: Based on the relative weight gain (RWG) of crucian carp under high stocking density, breakpoint analysis estimated the optimal dietary EML supplementation level to be 4.85 g/kg feed.

quote: The Cu exposure reduced the feed intake of the fish, and EML mitigated the disruptive effect of Cu stress on their digestive and absorptive capacities, as well as their antioxidant status.
statement: 铜暴露降低了鱼类的摄食量，而EML减轻了铜胁迫对其消化吸收能力和抗氧化状态的破坏作用。
text_zh: 铜暴露降低了鱼类的摄食量，而EML减轻了铜胁迫对其消化吸收能力和抗氧化状态的破坏作用。
text_en: Copper exposure reduced feed intake in fish, while EML mitigated the disruptive effects of copper stress on their digestion and absorption capacity and antioxidant status.
outcome: 消化功能与抗氧化状态

quote: The optimum amount of dietary EML supplementation was 4.52 g kg/diet for crucian carp under Cu stress.
statement: 在铜胁迫下，鲫鱼的最佳膳食EML添加量为4.52 g/kg饲料。
text_zh: 在铜胁迫下，鲫鱼的最佳膳食EML添加量为4.52 g/kg饲料。
text_en: Under copper stress, the optimal dietary EML supplementation level for crucian carp is 4.52 g/kg feed.

quote: Additionally, trichlorfon exposure induced detrimental effects, as indicated by the rollover of crucian carp.
statement: 此外，敌百虫暴露引起了有害影响，表现为鲫鱼侧翻。
text_zh: 此外，敌百虫暴露引起了有害影响，表现为鲫鱼侧翻。
text_en: In addition, trichlorfon exposure caused harmful effects, manifested as lateral recumbency in crucian carp.

quote: The addition of jabuticaba peel flour (JPF) promoted favorable changes in growth revealed in the results of the specific growth rate (SGR) and total consumption (Table 2).
statement: 添加贾布蒂卡巴果皮粉（JPF）促进了生长方面的有利变化，这体现在特定生长率（SGR）和总消耗量的结果中。
text_zh: 添加贾布蒂卡巴果皮粉（JPF）促进了生长方面的有利变化，这体现在特定生长率（SGR）和总消耗量的结果中。
text_en: Adding Jabuticaba peel powder (JPF) promoted favorable changes in growth, as reflected in the results for specific growth rate (SGR) and total consumption.

quote: The development of C. auratus improved when JPF was included in their diet, with an increase in total feed consumption promoted by the inclusion of JPF, demonstrating the acceptability and palatability of the product regardless of the level of inclusion.
statement: 在日粮中添加JPF改善了C. auratus的生长，并促进了总摄食量的增加，表明该产品具有可接受性和适口性。
text_zh: 在日粮中添加JPF改善了C. auratus的生长，并促进了总摄食量的增加，表明该产品具有可接受性和适口性。
text_en: Adding JPF to the diet improved the growth of C. auratus and promoted an increase in total feed intake, indicating that the product has acceptability and palatability.

quote: Effects of Curcuma longa rhizome on growth, skin pigmentation, and stress tolerance after transport of Tri
statement: 姜黄根茎对运输后鱼类的生长、皮肤色素沉着和应激耐受性有影响。
text_zh: 姜黄根茎对运输后鱼类的生长、皮肤色素沉着和应激耐受性有影响。
text_en: Curcuma longa rhizome affects the growth, skin pigmentation, and stress tolerance of fish after transport.
outcome: 生长、皮肤色素沉着、运输后应激耐受性
limitations: 物种名称在引文中被截断

quote: The assess fish skin pigmentation, six fish from each treatment were used. These fish were placed on a smooth white surface and sampled in the dorsal region, just below the dorsal fin, in the fish in vivo.
statement: 为了评估鱼皮色素沉着，每个处理组使用六条鱼，将它们放置在光滑的白色表面上，并在活体状态下于背鳍下方的背部区域进行采样。
text_zh: 为了评估鱼皮色素沉着，每个处理组使用六条鱼，将它们放置在光滑的白色表面上，并在活体状态下于背鳍下方的背部区域进行采样。
text_en: To assess skin pigmentation in fish, six fish per treatment group were placed on a smooth white surface and sampled in the dorsal area below the dorsal fin while alive.

quote: For blood tests, samples were obtained by veno-caudal puncture of three fish from each replicate using 3 mL heparinized syringes for glucose, triglycerides and cholesterol analyses.
statement: 对于血液测试，从每个重复组的三条鱼中通过尾静脉穿刺采集样本，使用3毫升肝素化注射器进行葡萄糖、甘油三酯和胆固醇分析。
text_zh: 对于血液测试，从每个重复组的三条鱼中通过尾静脉穿刺采集样本，使用3毫升肝素化注射器进行葡萄糖、甘油三酯和胆固醇分析。
text_en: For blood tests, samples were collected from three fish per replicate group via caudal vein puncture using a 3 ml heparinized syringe for glucose, triglyceride, and cholesterol analysis.

quote: After blood collection, the animals were anesthetized on ice sacrificed to remove liver and intestine samples.
statement: 采血后，动物在冰上麻醉并牺牲以移除肝脏和肠道样本。
text_zh: 采血后，动物在冰上麻醉并牺牲以移除肝脏和肠道样本。
text_en: After blood collection, the animals were anesthetized on ice and sacrificed to remove liver and intestinal samples.

quote: AST activity was higher in fish fed a diet containing 1.00% JPF (Table 3)
statement: 喂食含有1.00%贾巴提卡皮粉（JPF）的饲料的鱼，其天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性较高。
text_zh: 喂食含有1.00%贾巴提卡皮粉（JPF）的饲料的鱼，其天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性较高。
text_en: Fish fed a diet containing 1.00% Jaboticaba peel powder (JPF) had higher aspartate aminotransferase (AST) activity.

quote: ALT showed a reduction in its activity due to the variation in the inclusion of JPF when compared to the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，由于JPF添加量的变化，丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，由于JPF添加量的变化，丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) activity decreased due to changes in JPF supplementation levels.

quote: In this study, we observed that the inclusion of JPF promotes the growth of C. auratus
statement: 本研究观察到，在饲料中添加嘉宝果果皮粉（JPF）促进了金鱼（C. auratus）的生长。
text_zh: 本研究观察到，在饲料中添加嘉宝果果皮粉（JPF）促进了金鱼（C. auratus）的生长。
text_en: This study observed that adding Jabuticaba peel powder (JPF) to the feed promoted the growth of goldfish (C. auratus).

quote: The decrease in ALT, reveals the hepatoprotective effect of anthocyanins present in JPF.
statement: 丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）的降低揭示了JPF中存在的花青素的肝保护作用。
text_zh: 丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）的降低揭示了JPF中存在的花青素的肝保护作用。
text_en: The decrease in alanine aminotransferase (ALT) revealed the hepatoprotective effect of anthocyanins present in JPF.

quote: Changes in AST activities are considered insignificant in this situation where the values below those of reference for these enzymes are observed (compared to the control group).
statement: 在这种情况下，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性的变化被认为是不显著的，因为观察到的数值低于这些酶的参考值（与对照组相比）。
text_zh: 在这种情况下，天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性的变化被认为是不显著的，因为观察到的数值低于这些酶的参考值（与对照组相比）。
text_en: In this case, the change in aspartate aminotransferase (AST) activity was considered not significant because the observed values were lower than the reference values for these enzymes (compared to the control group).

quote: These results are corroborated by production of albumin that is synthesized exclusively in the liver, which has increased activity compared to the control group, ensuring the hepatoprotective effect (Silva et al. 2011).
statement: 这些结果得到了白蛋白产生的佐证，白蛋白仅在肝脏中合成，其活性较对照组增加，从而确保了肝保护作用。
text_zh: 这些结果得到了白蛋白产生的佐证，白蛋白仅在肝脏中合成，其活性较对照组增加，从而确保了肝保护作用。
text_en: These results were corroborated by albumin production, which is synthesized only in the liver and whose activity increased compared to the control group, thereby ensuring hepatoprotective effects.
outcome: 肝脏健康/血清生化指标

quote: the triglyceride values did not differ, however, the inclusion of 2.00% JPF increased circulating glucose in C. auratus .
statement: 甘油三酯值没有差异，但添加2.00%的JPF增加了C. auratus血液中的循环葡萄糖水平。
text_zh: 甘油三酯值没有差异，但添加2.00%的JPF增加了C. auratus血液中的循环葡萄糖水平。
text_en: There was no difference in triglyceride values, but the addition of 2.00% JPF increased circulating glucose levels in the blood of C. auratus.
outcome: 生化指标（血糖/脂质代谢）

quote: Regarding digestive enzymes, a significant difference (P > 0.05) was observed regarding lipase in groups with 1.00 and 2.00% inclusion of JPF.
statement: 关于消化酶，在添加1.00%和2.00% JPF的组中观察到脂肪酶存在显著差异（注：原文标注P>0.05，通常指不显著，此处保留原文陈述）。
text_zh: 关于消化酶，在添加1.00%和2.00% JPF的组中观察到脂肪酶存在显著差异（注：原文标注P>0.05，通常指不显著，此处保留原文陈述）。
text_en: Regarding digestive enzymes, a significant difference in lipase was observed in the groups supplemented with 1.00% and 2.00% JPF (Note: The original text marks P>0.05, which usually indicates non-significance; the original statement is retained here).

quote: he action of plants as hepatoprotective with decreased ALT and AST activity is reported in fish (Fuentes-Quesada et al. 2018 ; Ota et al. 2019).
statement: 植物在鱼类中表现出保肝作用，可降低ALT和AST活性。
text_zh: 植物在鱼类中表现出保肝作用，可降低ALT和AST活性。
text_en: Plants exhibit hepatoprotective effects in fish, reducing ALT and AST activities.

quote: The change in digestive lipase activity may be indicative of an improvement in digestion rates compared to the use of nutritional additives.
statement: 消化脂肪酶活性的变化可能表明与使用营养添加剂相比，消化率有所改善。
text_zh: 消化脂肪酶活性的变化可能表明与使用营养添加剂相比，消化率有所改善。
text_en: Changes in digestive lipase activity may indicate improved digestibility compared to the use of nutritional additives.

quote: The high alkalinity and pH levels adversely affect the growth, survival, and reproductive capacity of fish, presenting significant challenges for aquaculture practices
statement: 高碱度和pH水平对鱼类的生长、存活和繁殖能力产生不利影响，给水产养殖实践带来重大挑战。
text_zh: 高碱度和pH水平对鱼类的生长、存活和繁殖能力产生不利影响，给水产养殖实践带来重大挑战。
text_en: High alkalinity and pH levels adversely affect fish growth, survival, and reproductive capacity, posing significant challenges to aquaculture practices.

quote: As aquatic organisms, fish are continuously subjected to a variety of stressors that lead to the development of complex immunomodulatory networks aimed at ensuring effective immune responses and maintaining homeostatic balance
statement: 作为水生生物，鱼类持续受到多种应激源的影响，导致形成复杂的免疫调节网络，旨在确保有效的免疫反应并维持稳态平衡。
text_zh: 作为水生生物，鱼类持续受到多种应激源的影响，导致形成复杂的免疫调节网络，旨在确保有效的免疫反应并维持稳态平衡。
text_en: As aquatic organisms, fish are continuously affected by multiple stressors, leading to the formation of a complex immune regulation network aimed at ensuring effective immune responses and maintaining homeostatic balance.

quote: We investigated the potential use of mucus composition as an indicator of physiological response by assessing how these two populations of crucian carp respond to alkali-salt stresses and measuring proteomic alterations in their mucus.
statement: The study investigates the potential use of mucus composition as an indicator of physiological response to alkali-salt stress in crucian carp.
text_en: The study investigates the potential use of mucus composition as an indicator of physiological response to alkali-salt stress in crucian carp.

quote: This study aimed to examine the alterations in the protein composition of skin mucus among freshwater and alkaline water populations of crucian carp subjected to elevated NaHCO 3 alkalinity stress.
statement: The study aims to examine changes in skin mucus protein composition in crucian carp exposed to high NaHCO3 alkalinity stress.
text_en: The study aims to examine changes in skin mucus protein composition in crucian carp exposed to high NaHCO3 alkalinity stress.

quote: Our findings enhance the understanding of how crucian carp respond to environmental alkalinity through the analysis of skin mucus.
statement: The findings improve the understanding of crucian carp responses to environmental alkalinity via skin mucus analysis.
text_en: The findings improve the understanding of crucian carp responses to environmental alkalinity via skin mucus analysis.

quote: In freshwater populations, 232 differentially expressed proteins were predominantly enriched in the following categories: immune system process (GO:0002376, biological process), response to biotic stimulus (GO:0009607, biological process), lipid transporter activity (GO:0005319, molecular function), metalloendopeptidase activity (GO:0004222, molecular function), integral component of organelle membrane (GO:0031301, cellular component), and protein–DNA complex formation (GO:0032993, cellular component).
statement: 在高碱胁迫实验中，淡水种群有232个差异表达蛋白主要富集在免疫系统过程、对生物刺激的反应、脂质转运活性等类别中。
text_zh: 在高碱胁迫实验中，淡水种群有232个差异表达蛋白主要富集在免疫系统过程、对生物刺激的反应、脂质转运活性等类别中。
text_en: In the high alkalinity stress experiment, 232 differentially expressed proteins in freshwater populations were mainly enriched in categories such as immune system process, response to biological stimulus, and lipid transport activity.
outcome: 高碱胁迫下的生理响应与免疫相关分子机制

quote: It is notable for being one of the few freshwater aquaculture species capable of tolerating high levels of alkaline stress
statement: 鲫鱼是少数能够耐受高碱度胁迫的淡水养殖物种之一。
text_zh: 鲫鱼是少数能够耐受高碱度胁迫的淡水养殖物种之一。
text_en: Crucian carp is one of the few freshwater aquaculture species capable of tolerating high alkalinity stress.

quote: However, limited research has been conducted on skin mucus to investigate the responses of crucian carp to salt and alkali stress thus far.
statement: 然而，迄今为止，关于通过皮肤黏液研究鲫鱼对盐和碱胁迫反应的研究有限。
text_zh: 然而，迄今为止，关于通过皮肤黏液研究鲫鱼对盐和碱胁迫反应的研究有限。
text_en: However, to date, research on the response of crucian carp to salt and alkali stress through skin mucus is limited.

quote: Thus, we conclude that the inclusion of jabuticaba peel flour is efficient as a food additive, with the most effective concentration being 1.5% of inclusion.
statement: 结论认为添加嘉宝果果皮粉作为饲料添加剂是有效的，最佳浓度为1.5%。
text_zh: 结论认为添加嘉宝果果皮粉作为饲料添加剂是有效的，最佳浓度为1.5%。
text_en: The conclusion states that adding jabuticaba peel powder as a feed additive is effective, with an optimal concentration of 1.5%.

quote: Investigating the response of skin mucus to various toxic stresses is crucial for enhancing its ability to tackle environmental challenges and developing strategies to mitigate toxic effects.
statement: 研究皮肤黏液对毒性应激的反应对于增强鱼类应对环境挑战的能力以及开发减轻毒性效应的策略至关重要。
text_zh: 研究皮肤黏液对毒性应激的反应对于增强鱼类应对环境挑战的能力以及开发减轻毒性效应的策略至关重要。
text_en: Studying the response of skin mucus to toxic stress is crucial for enhancing fish resilience to environmental challenges and developing strategies to mitigate toxic effects.

quote: Alkalinity stress assays (50 mmol/L NaHCO 3) were conducted on crucian carp (Carassius auratus) from Lake Dali Nur (pH = 9.6) and Ping Xiang red crucian carp from freshwater (pH = 7) over 7 days.
statement: 对来自达里湖（pH=9.6）的鲫鱼和来自淡水（pH=7）的平乡红鲫进行了为期7天的碱度应激试验（50 mmol/L NaHCO3）。
text_zh: 对来自达里湖（pH=9.6）的鲫鱼和来自淡水（pH=7）的平乡红鲫进行了为期7天的碱度应激试验（50 mmol/L NaHCO3）。
text_en: A 7-day alkalinity stress test (50 mmol/L NaHCO3) was conducted on crucian carp from Dali Lake (pH=9.6) and Pingxiang red crucian carp from freshwater (pH=7).

quote: In the alkaline water population, high alkali stress resulted in the up-regulation of 139 proteins and the down-regulation of 500 proteins.
statement: 在碱性水种群中，高碱应激导致139种蛋白质上调和500种蛋白质下调。
text_zh: 在碱性水种群中，高碱应激导致139种蛋白质上调和500种蛋白质下调。
text_en: In alkaline water populations, high alkali stress led to the upregulation of 139 proteins and the downregulation of 500 proteins.

quote: In alkaline water populations, a comprehensive analysis of differential protein expression revealed that 139 proteins were significantly up-regulated, while 500 proteins were significantly down-regulated following exposure to high alkali stress.
statement: 在碱性水种群中，暴露于高碱胁迫后，139种蛋白质显著上调，500种蛋白质显著下调。
text_zh: 在碱性水种群中，暴露于高碱胁迫后，139种蛋白质显著上调，500种蛋白质显著下调。
text_en: In alkaline water populations, after exposure to high alkalinity stress, 139 proteins were significantly upregulated and 500 proteins were significantly downregulated.
outcome: 应激反应（蛋白质表达变化）

quote: In contrast, freshwater populations exhibited a comparative assessment showing that 112 proteins were up-regulated and 120 were down-regulated.
statement: 相比之下，淡水种群显示有112种蛋白质上调，120种蛋白质下调。
text_zh: 相比之下，淡水种群显示有112种蛋白质上调，120种蛋白质下调。
text_en: In contrast, freshwater populations showed 112 proteins upregulated and 120 proteins downregulated.
outcome: 应激反应（蛋白质表达变化）

quote: Typically, alkaline tolerance is assessed by measuring the survival rate after a 96-h exposure to alkaline conditions or by determining the semi-lethal concentration during the period of alkaline stress [ 23 , 24 ].
statement: 通常通过测量碱性条件下暴露96小时后的存活率或确定碱胁迫期间的半致死浓度来评估耐碱性。
text_zh: 通常通过测量碱性条件下暴露96小时后的存活率或确定碱胁迫期间的半致死浓度来评估耐碱性。
text_en: Alkalinity tolerance is usually assessed by measuring survival after 96 hours of exposure under alkaline conditions or by determining the median lethal concentration during alkali stress.

quote: However, these conventional methods do not accurately reflect long-term tolerance to alkaline environments and significantly differ from actual commercial aquaculture settings and cycles.
statement: 这些常规方法不能准确反映对碱性环境的长期耐受性，并且与实际商业养殖环境和周期存在显著差异。
text_zh: 这些常规方法不能准确反映对碱性环境的长期耐受性，并且与实际商业养殖环境和周期存在显著差异。
text_en: These conventional methods cannot accurately reflect long-term tolerance to alkaline environments, and there are significant differences from actual commercial aquaculture environments and cycles.
outcome: 环境适应性评估准确性

quote: Therefore, in this study, we extended the traditional 96-h stress period to 7 days in order to better simulate the real conditions encountered in commercial aquaculture.
statement: 因此，在本研究中，我们将传统的96小时胁迫期延长至7天，以更好地模拟商业养殖中遇到的实际条件。
text_zh: 因此，在本研究中，我们将传统的96小时胁迫期延长至7天，以更好地模拟商业养殖中遇到的实际条件。
text_en: Therefore, in this study, we extended the traditional 96-hour stress period to 7 days to better simulate the actual conditions encountered in commercial aquaculture.

quote: vas Frente a restrição alimentar de Peixes ornamentais.
statement: A restrição alimentar afeta peixes ornamentais.
text_en: A restrição alimentar afeta peixes ornamentais.

quote: The behavioural effects of supplementing diets with synthetic and naturally sourced Astaxanthin in an ornamental fish (Puntius titteya).
statement: A suplementação da dieta com astaxantina sintética e natural tem efeitos comportamentais em um peixe ornamental.
text_en: A suplementação da dieta com astaxantina sintética e natural tem efeitos comportamentais em um peixe ornamental.

quote: Enteritis induction by soybean meal in Totoaba macdonaldidiets: effects on growth performance, digestive capacity, immune response and distal intestine integrity.
statement: A indução de enterite por farinha de soja nas dietas de Totoaba macdonaldi afeta o crescimento, capacidade digestiva, resposta imune e integridade do intestino distal.
text_en: A indução de enterite por farinha de soja nas dietas de Totoaba macdonaldi afeta o crescimento, capacidade digestiva, resposta imune e integridade do intestino distal.

quote: Aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) reduces growth performance, physiological response, and disease resistance in Tra catfish (Pangasius hypophthalmus).
statement: A aflatoxina B1 reduz o desempenho de crescimento, a resposta fisiológica e a resistência a doenças no bagre Tra.
text_en: A aflatoxina B1 reduz o desempenho de crescimento, a resposta fisiológica e a resistência a doenças no bagre Tra.

quote: An increase in the expression level of this protein indicates that alkalinity stress leads to a significant elevation in inflammatory responses.
statement: 角蛋白表达水平的升高表明碱胁迫导致炎症反应显著加剧。
text_zh: 角蛋白表达水平的升高表明碱胁迫导致炎症反应显著加剧。
text_en: The increase in keratin expression levels indicates that alkaline stress significantly exacerbates the inflammatory response.
counterevidence: 碱胁迫引起显著的炎症反应升高。

quote: identifying biomarkers associated with alkali tolerance enables the precise evaluation of their impacts on growth performance, feed utilization efficiency, immune health, product quality, and safety, as well as exacerbation of fish diseases
statement: 识别与耐碱性相关的生物标志物能够精确评估其对生长性能、饲料利用效率、免疫健康、产品质量和安全以及鱼类疾病加剧的影响。
text_zh: 识别与耐碱性相关的生物标志物能够精确评估其对生长性能、饲料利用效率、免疫健康、产品质量和安全以及鱼类疾病加剧的影响。
text_en: Identifying biomarkers associated with alkalinity tolerance can precisely assess their impact on growth performance, feed utilization efficiency, immune health, product quality and safety, and the exacerbation of fish diseases.
outcome: 生长性能、免疫健康及疾病风险

quote: highly alkaline water directly influences the equilibrium between gaseous NH 3 and NH 4 + in fish, potentially giving rise to NH 3 retention and the augmentation of endogenous NH 3
statement: 高碱性水直接影响鱼体内气态NH3和NH4+之间的平衡，可能导致NH3滞留和内源性NH3增加。
text_zh: 高碱性水直接影响鱼体内气态NH3和NH4+之间的平衡，可能导致NH3滞留和内源性NH3增加。
text_en: Highly alkaline water directly affects the balance between gaseous NH3 and NH4+ in fish bodies, which may lead to NH3 retention and an increase in endogenous NH3.

quote: reduced levels of blood and water ΔPNH 3 (ammonia partial pressure gradient) might hamper the efficacy of ammonia excretion
statement: 血液和水中的ΔPNH3（氨分压梯度）水平降低可能会阻碍氨排泄的效率。
text_zh: 血液和水中的ΔPNH3（氨分压梯度）水平降低可能会阻碍氨排泄的效率。
text_en: A decrease in ΔPNH3 (ammonia partial pressure gradient) levels in blood and water may hinder the efficiency of ammonia excretion.

quote: Ineffective ammonia excretion is capable of leading to an excessive accumulation of endogenous ammonia, exerting an influence on exercise performance and blood indicators, modifying energy mobilization and metabolic patterns, and interfering with ion regulation
statement: 无效的氨排泄会导致内源性氨过度积累，从而影响运动性能和血液指标，改变能量动员和代谢模式，并干扰离子调节。
text_zh: 无效的氨排泄会导致内源性氨过度积累，从而影响运动性能和血液指标，改变能量动员和代谢模式，并干扰离子调节。
text_en: Ineffective ammonia excretion leads to excessive accumulation of endogenous ammonia, thereby affecting exercise performance and blood indicators, altering energy mobilization and metabolic patterns, and interfering with ion regulation.
outcome: 运动性能、代谢及离子调节

quote: The KEGG enrichment pathways for these populations under high alkali stress demonstrated significant differences.
statement: 在强碱胁迫下，不同种群的KEGG富集通路表现出显著差异。
text_zh: 在强碱胁迫下，不同种群的KEGG富集通路表现出显著差异。
text_en: Under strong alkaline stress, KEGG enriched pathways showed significant differences among different populations.

quote: Furthermore, the ‘B 09151 Immune system’ displayed a significantly higher abundance of differentially expressed proteins (Figure 6).
statement: 此外，“B 09151 免疫系统”通路显示出显著更高丰度的差异表达蛋白。
text_zh: 此外，“B 09151 免疫系统”通路显示出显著更高丰度的差异表达蛋白。
text_en: In addition, the "B 09151 Immune system" pathway showed significantly higher abundance of differentially expressed proteins.

quote: The experimental water contained dissolved oxygen levels averaging (7.51 ± 0.65) mg/L and temperatures of approximately (17.84 ± 2.73 °C); meanwhile, the measured alkalinity of the control group was (0.51 ± 0.04) mM compared to (50.65 ± 1.35) mM in the experimental group.
text_en: The average dissolved oxygen in the water of the experimental group was (7.51 ± 0.65) mg/L, the temperature was about (17.84 ± 2.73 °C), and the alkalinity was (50.65 ± 1.35) mM, while the alkalinity of the control group was (0.51 ± 0.04) mM.
outcome: 水质参数（溶解氧、温度、碱度）

quote: Subsequent to the 7-day alkali stress experiment, five fish from each group were carefully selected and anesthetized with MS-222 (Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA).
statement: 在7天碱胁迫实验后，从每组中仔细挑选五条鱼并用MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在7天碱胁迫实验后，从每组中仔细挑选五条鱼并用MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: After a 7-day alkaline stress experiment, five fish were carefully selected from each group and anesthetized with MS-222.
outcome: 采样前的动物处理（麻醉）

quote: Results from GO and KEGG enrichment analyses revealed that many differentially expressed proteins are linked to immune system functions.
statement: GO和KEGG富集分析结果显示，许多差异表达蛋白与免疫系统功能相关。
text_zh: GO和KEGG富集分析结果显示，许多差异表达蛋白与免疫系统功能相关。
text_en: GO and KEGG enrichment analysis results showed that many differentially expressed proteins are related to immune system function.

quote: Research into how skin mucus responds to toxic stresses is essential for enhancing coping mechanisms and developing strategies aimed at mitigating toxic effects [ 17 , 18 ].
statement: 研究皮肤黏液对毒性应激的反应对于增强应对机制和开发减轻毒性效应的策略至关重要。
text_zh: 研究皮肤黏液对毒性应激的反应对于增强应对机制和开发减轻毒性效应的策略至关重要。
text_en: Studying the response of skin mucus to toxic stress is crucial for enhancing coping mechanisms and developing strategies to mitigate toxic effects.

quote: Considering modifications in the composition of skin mucus during prolonged exposure to alkali and salt stress within commercial cultures in saline waters, we selected two populations of crucian carp: one from an extremely alkaline environment and another from freshwater.
statement: 鉴于在咸水商业养殖中长时间暴露于碱盐胁迫下皮肤黏液成分的变化，研究者选择了两个鲫鱼种群：一个来自极碱性环境，另一个来自淡水。
text_zh: 鉴于在咸水商业养殖中长时间暴露于碱盐胁迫下皮肤黏液成分的变化，研究者选择了两个鲫鱼种群：一个来自极碱性环境，另一个来自淡水。
text_en: Given the changes in skin mucus composition due to prolonged exposure to alkaline salt stress in commercial brackish water aquaculture, researchers selected two crucian carp populations: one from an extremely alkaline environment and the other from freshwater.
outcome: 碱盐胁迫下的生理适应

quote: In this extreme aquatic environment, where alkalinity levels can reach up to 50 mmol/L NaHCO 3 (pH = 9.6), crucian carp not only survive but also thrive; they are among the few fish species capable of reproducing and growing under such challenging conditions.
statement: 在这个极端水生环境中（碱度高达50 mmol/L NaHCO3，pH=9.6），鲫鱼不仅存活而且茁壮成长；它们是少数能在如此挑战性条件下繁殖和生长的鱼类之一。
text_zh: 在这个极端水生环境中（碱度高达50 mmol/L NaHCO3，pH=9.6），鲫鱼不仅存活而且茁壮成长；它们是少数能在如此挑战性条件下繁殖和生长的鱼类之一。
text_en: In this extreme aquatic environment (alkalinity up to 50 mmol/L NaHCO3, pH=9.6), crucian carp not only survived but thrived; they are one of the few fish species capable of reproducing and growing under such challenging conditions.

quote: Food was withheld for a duration of 48 h prior to the alkalinity tolerance test.
statement: 在碱度耐受性测试前禁食48小时。
text_zh: 在碱度耐受性测试前禁食48小时。
text_en: Fasting for 48 hours before the alkalinity tolerance test.
outcome: 应激处理前的生理状态准备

quote: A total of thirty fish from each group were placed in a 400 L indoor circulating aquarium (177 cm × 57 cm × 40 cm) for a period of seven days for an alkalinity stress assay.
statement: 每组30条鱼被放入400升室内循环水族箱中进行为期七天的碱度胁迫试验。
text_zh: 每组30条鱼被放入400升室内循环水族箱中进行为期七天的碱度胁迫试验。
text_en: Groups of 30 fish were placed in 400-liter indoor recirculating aquaria for a seven-day alkalinity stress trial.
outcome: 环境胁迫下的生存与适应

quote: Throughout the experiment, no feeding was implemented; nonetheless, oxygenation persisted, half of the water volume was exchanged daily, and various water quality parameters were monitored.
statement: 在整个实验期间不喂食，但持续充氧，每天交换一半的水量，并监测各种水质参数。
text_zh: 在整个实验期间不喂食，但持续充氧，每天交换一半的水量，并监测各种水质参数。
text_en: No feeding was provided throughout the entire experimental period, but aeration was maintained continuously, half of the water volume was exchanged daily, and various water quality parameters were monitored.
outcome: 水质稳定性与动物福利

quote: The log2FoldChange values were derived from the differential analysis of protein sequences between alkaline and freshwater populations subjected to 7-day high alkalinity stress.
statement: 通过比较经历7天高碱胁迫的碱性种群和淡水种群的蛋白质序列差异分析，获得了log2FoldChange值。
text_zh: 通过比较经历7天高碱胁迫的碱性种群和淡水种群的蛋白质序列差异分析，获得了log2FoldChange值。
text_en: Log2FoldChange values were obtained by analyzing protein sequence differences between alkaline populations and freshwater populations subjected to 7 days of high-alkalinity stress.

quote: Notably, the alpha-globin fragment was up-regulated by hundreds or even thousands of folds in both populations in response to high alkali stress.
statement: 值得注意的是，在响应高碱胁迫时，两个种群中的α-珠蛋白片段均上调了数百甚至数千倍。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，在响应高碱胁迫时，两个种群中的α-珠蛋白片段均上调了数百甚至数千倍。
text_en: It is worth noting that, in response to high alkalinity stress, the alpha-globin fragments in both populations were upregulated by hundreds or even thousands of times.

quote: In the present study, a freshwater control group and an alkalinity treatment group (50 mmol/L, NaHCO 3) were, respectively, established for the alkaline population originating from Lake Dali Nur with a pH value of 9.6, and the freshwater population of red crucian carp originating from Pingxiang, Jiangxi Province, where the water environment has a pH value of 7.
statement: 研究建立了淡水对照组和碱度处理组（50 mmol/L，NaHCO3），分别针对来自pH值为9.6的大理洱海的碱性种群和来自江西萍乡、水环境pH值为7的淡水红鲫种群。
text_zh: 研究建立了淡水对照组和碱度处理组（50 mmol/L，NaHCO3），分别针对来自pH值为9.6的大理洱海的碱性种群和来自江西萍乡、水环境pH值为7的淡水红鲫种群。
text_en: The study established a freshwater control group and an alkalinity treatment group (50 mmol/L, NaHCO3), targeting respectively the alkaline population from Dali Erhai Lake with a pH of 9.6 and the freshwater red crucian carp population from Pingxiang, Jiangxi, with a water environment pH of 7.

quote: A total of 150 individuals... were randomly selected for temporary feeding in an indoor circulation tank over the course of one week.
statement: 总共随机选择了150条鱼在室内循环水箱中暂养一周。
text_zh: 总共随机选择了150条鱼在室内循环水箱中暂养一周。
text_en: A total of 150 fish were randomly selected and held in indoor recirculating water tanks for one week.

quote: These fish demonstrated strong activity, were healthy, and were free from injury.
statement: 这些鱼表现出强烈的活动性，健康且无受伤。
text_zh: 这些鱼表现出强烈的活动性，健康且无受伤。
text_en: These fish showed strong activity, were healthy and uninjured.

quote: During the period of temporary maintenance, appropriate daily feeding was administered, continuous oxygenation was ensured, and a water change equivalent to one-third of the tank volume was performed every other day.
statement: 在暂养期间，进行了适当的每日喂食，确保持续充氧，并每隔一天更换相当于水箱体积三分之一的水。
text_zh: 在暂养期间，进行了适当的每日喂食，确保持续充氧，并每隔一天更换相当于水箱体积三分之一的水。
text_en: During the holding period, appropriate daily feeding was conducted, continuous aeration was ensured, and one-third of the tank volume was replaced with fresh water every other day.
intervention: Daily feeding, aeration and alternate-day water change during holding
intervention_record: 暂养期日常喂食、充氧、隔日换水

quote: The experimental water maintained an average dissolved oxygen level of (7.51 ± 0.65) mg/L, with a temperature of approximately (17.84 ± 2.73 °C)
statement: 实验水维持平均溶解氧水平为(7.51 ± 0.65) mg/L，温度约为(17.84 ± 2.73 °C)。
text_zh: 实验水维持平均溶解氧水平为(7.51 ± 0.65) mg/L，温度约为(17.84 ± 2.73 °C)。
text_en: The experimental water maintained an average dissolved oxygen level of (7.51 ± 0.65) mg/L, and a temperature of about (17.84 ± 2.73 °C).

quote: An increase in sodium bicarbonate alkalinity leads to elevated concentrations of exogenous ammonia nitrogen, which hinders the metabolism and transformation of endogenous nitrogen, ultimately affecting the physiological levels of ammonia excretion
statement: 碳酸氢钠碱度的增加导致外源性氨氮浓度升高，阻碍内源性氮的代谢和转化，最终影响氨排泄的生理水平。
text_zh: 碳酸氢钠碱度的增加导致外源性氨氮浓度升高，阻碍内源性氮的代谢和转化，最终影响氨排泄的生理水平。
text_en: The increase in sodium bicarbonate alkalinity leads to elevated exogenous ammonia nitrogen concentrations, hindering the metabolism and transformation of endogenous nitrogen, ultimately affecting the physiological level of ammonia excretion.

quote: In the present study, all the animal experiments were handled in accordance with the guidelines for the Care and Use of Experimental Animals of China.
statement: 本研究中所有动物实验均按照中国《实验动物饲养和使用指南》进行处理。
text_zh: 本研究中所有动物实验均按照中国《实验动物饲养和使用指南》进行处理。
text_en: All animal experiments in this study were conducted in accordance with the Chinese "Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals".

quote: After bringing the fish to the lab, we first performed PCR to make sure that the fish did not carry the CyHV-2 and then did further research (Figure S1).
statement: 将鱼带回实验室后，首先进行PCR以确保鱼不携带CyHV-2，然后进行进一步研究。
text_zh: 将鱼带回实验室后，首先进行PCR以确保鱼不携带CyHV-2，然后进行进一步研究。
text_en: After bringing the fish back to the laboratory, PCR was first performed to ensure that the fish did not carry CyHV-2, followed by further research.

quote: Briefly, fish were anesthetized with tricaine methane sulfonate (MS-222) at 100 mg L −1 and inoculated with a CyHV-2 working solution (9.7×10 6 copies μl −1) at 10 μl fish -1 into their gills (both sides) in air.
statement: 鱼用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉后，在空气中向两侧鳃部接种每尾10微升的CyHV-2工作液。
text_zh: 鱼用100 mg/L的MS-222麻醉后，在空气中向两侧鳃部接种每尾10微升的CyHV-2工作液。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222, and then inoculated with 10 microliters of CyHV-2 working solution per fish into both gills during air exposure.

quote: After gill exposure to the viral solution or PBS, fish were wrapped with wet papers and kept in air for 5–7 min at 25°C to allow the virus to adsorb into the gill tissue.
statement: 在鳃部暴露于病毒溶液或PBS后，用湿纸包裹鱼并在25°C空气中保持5-7分钟以允许病毒吸附到鳃组织。
text_zh: 在鳃部暴露于病毒溶液或PBS后，用湿纸包裹鱼并在25°C空气中保持5-7分钟以允许病毒吸附到鳃组织。
text_en: After gill exposure to virus solution or PBS, wrap the fish in wet paper and keep it in air at 25°C for 5-7 minutes to allow virus adsorption to gill tissue.
intervention: Wet paper wrapping with aerial exposure

quote: During the challenge test, no diets were fed (Qiao et al., 2020).
statement: 在攻毒试验期间不投喂饲料。
text_zh: 在攻毒试验期间不投喂饲料。
text_en: No feed was provided during the challenge test.

quote: Clinical symptoms were observed daily, focusing on lethargy, anorexia, and hemorrhage in the body, eye, gill, and swim bladder.
statement: 每日观察临床症状，重点关注嗜睡、厌食以及身体、眼睛、鳃和 Swim bladder 的出血。
text_zh: 每日观察临床症状，重点关注嗜睡、厌食以及身体、眼睛、鳃和 Swim bladder 的出血。
text_en: Clinical signs were observed daily, with a focus on lethargy, anorexia, and hemorrhage of the body, eyes, gills, and swim bladder.
outcome: 健康状态指标（嗜睡、厌食、出血）

quote: The fish were acclimated in a tank with static water at a water temperature of 23°C–25°C, pH of 7.8–8.2, and dissolved oxygen (DO) higher than 5 mg L −1 and provided with 24-h continuous aeration circulation for 2 weeks prior to the experiments.
statement: 实验前将鱼在静水、特定水质参数（温度23-25°C，pH 7.8-8.2，溶氧>5 mg/L）及24小时连续曝气条件下驯化2周。
text_zh: 实验前将鱼在静水、特定水质参数（温度23-25°C，pH 7.8-8.2，溶氧>5 mg/L）及24小时连续曝气条件下驯化2周。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were acclimated for 2 weeks under static water conditions with specific water quality parameters (temperature 23-25°C, pH 7.8-8.2, dissolved oxygen >5 mg/L) and continuous aeration for 24 hours.
intervention: Environmental acclimation and water quality control

quote: Gibel carp was fed three times each day with commercial diets (Tongwei, Yancheng, China) to satiation.
statement: 每日投喂商业饲料三次至饱食。
text_zh: 每日投喂商业饲料三次至饱食。
text_en: Commercial feed was fed three times daily to satiation.

quote: Based on the results from part 2.6.1 and Aeromonas frequent infection in gibel carp culture practice, the time-course abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut of fish after infected by CyHV-2 was detected.
statement: Aeromonas感染在鲫鱼养殖实践中频繁发生，因此检测了CyHV-2感染后鱼中肠内气单胞菌随时间的丰度变化。
text_zh: Aeromonas感染在鲫鱼养殖实践中频繁发生，因此检测了CyHV-2感染后鱼中肠内气单胞菌随时间的丰度变化。
text_en: Aeromonas infection frequently occurs in crucian carp farming practices, so the temporal changes in Aeromonas abundance in the midgut of fish after CyHV-2 infection were detected.

quote: The midgut of fish at 0, 1, 4, and 5 dpi was collected and homogenized in precold PBS. Then, the homogenate was diluted and spread on the RS selective medium, which was cultured at 28°C for 24–48 h. Bacterial colonies were counted and converted into the CFU g -1 midgut.
statement: 通过采集不同时间点（0、1、4和5 dpi）的鱼中肠，在预冷PBS中匀浆，稀释后涂布于RS选择性培养基并在28°C培养24-48小时，计数菌落并转换为CFU/g中肠以测定细菌丰度。
text_zh: 通过采集不同时间点（0、1、4和5 dpi）的鱼中肠，在预冷PBS中匀浆，稀释后涂布于RS选择性培养基并在28°C培养24-48小时，计数菌落并转换为CFU/g中肠以测定细菌丰度。
text_en: Bacterial abundance was determined by collecting fish midguts at different time points (0, 1, 4 and 5 dpi), homogenizing them in pre-cooled PBS, diluting, plating on RS selective medium, incubating at 28°C for 24-48 hours, counting colonies and converting to CFU/g midgut.
intervention_record: 培养法监测气单胞菌丰度
outcome: 肠道菌群/病原负荷监测

quote: CyHV-2 infection increased the relative abundance of Aeromonas spp. and decreased Cetobacterium in the midgut significantly
statement: CyHV-2感染显著增加了中肠中气单胞菌属的相对丰度并降低了鲸杆菌属的相对丰度。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染显著增加了中肠中气单胞菌属的相对丰度并降低了鲸杆菌属的相对丰度。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection significantly increased the relative abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut and decreased the relative abundance of Cetobacterium.

quote: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) infects gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio) and causes severe losses.
statement: CyHV-2感染导致银鲫严重损失。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染导致银鲫严重损失。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection causes severe losses in gibel carp.

quote: Results showed that CyHV-2 infection significantly changed gut microbiota and metabolite profiles (p Aeromonas in the midgut increased dramatically while Cetobacterium decreased.
statement: CyHV-2感染显著改变了肠道微生物群和代谢物谱，其中气单胞菌大幅增加而鲸杆菌减少。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染显著改变了肠道微生物群和代谢物谱，其中气单胞菌大幅增加而鲸杆菌减少。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection significantly altered the gut microbiota and metabolite profile, with a substantial increase in Aeromonas and a decrease in Cetobacterium.

quote: Time-course analysis showed that the number of Aeromonas in the midgut of infected fish increased more than 1,000 times within 5 days post infection.
statement: 时间进程分析显示，感染后5天内，受感染鱼中肠的气单胞菌数量增加了1000倍以上。
text_zh: 时间进程分析显示，感染后5天内，受感染鱼中肠的气单胞菌数量增加了1000倍以上。
text_en: Time-course analysis showed that within 5 days post-infection, the number of Aeromonas in the intestines of infected fish increased by more than 1000-fold.

quote: Metabolome analysis illustrated that CyHV-2 infection significantly altered 24 metabolites in the midgut of gibel carp, annotating to the anomaly of digestion and metabolisms of amino acids, carbohydrates, and lipids, such as tryptophan (Trp) metabolism.
statement: 代谢组学分析表明，CyHV-2感染显著改变了银鲫中肠的24种代谢物，指向氨基酸、碳水化合物和脂质（如色氨酸代谢）的消化和代谢异常。
text_zh: 代谢组学分析表明，CyHV-2感染显著改变了银鲫中肠的24种代谢物，指向氨基酸、碳水化合物和脂质（如色氨酸代谢）的消化和代谢异常。
text_en: Metabolomic analysis showed that CyHV-2 infection significantly altered 24 metabolites in the midgut of gibel carp, indicating abnormalities in the digestion and metabolism of amino acids, carbohydrates, and lipids (such as tryptophan metabolism).
