quote: Results showed that modulating Trp metabolism could affect the relative abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut of fish, transcription of antiviral cytokines, and CyHV-2 infection.
statement: 结果表明，调节色氨酸代谢可以影响鱼中肠气单胞菌的相对丰度、抗病毒细胞因子的转录以及CyHV-2感染。
text_zh: 结果表明，调节色氨酸代谢可以影响鱼中肠气单胞菌的相对丰度、抗病毒细胞因子的转录以及CyHV-2感染。
text_en: The results showed that modulating tryptophan metabolism can affect the relative abundance of Aeromonas enterica in fish, the transcription of antiviral cytokines, and CyHV-2 infection.

quote: For gibel carp, the gut microbiota of fish post-CyHV-2 infection was changed, and Plesiomonas was highly abundant in the infected fish Rong et al., 2017 .
statement: 在感染CyHV-2后的鲫鱼中，肠道微生物群发生了变化，且嗜水气单胞菌属（Plesiomonas）在受感染的鱼中高度丰富。
text_zh: 在感染CyHV-2后的鲫鱼中，肠道微生物群发生了变化，且嗜水气单胞菌属（Plesiomonas）在受感染的鱼中高度丰富。
text_en: In crucian carp after CyHV-2 infection, the gut microbiota changed, and Plesiomonas was highly abundant in infected fish.

quote: Recent studies reveal that modulating the gut microbiota is an effective strategy to control disease development in human beings (Liu et al., 2013), but few studies were reported on the fish (Ran et al., 2021).
statement: 近期研究表明调节肠道微生物群是控制人类疾病发展的有效策略，但关于鱼类的研究报道很少。
text_zh: 近期研究表明调节肠道微生物群是控制人类疾病发展的有效策略，但关于鱼类的研究报道很少。
text_en: Recent studies have shown that modulating the gut microbiota is an effective strategy for controlling the development of human diseases, but there are few reports on fish.
limitations: few studies were reported on the fish

quote: Gut microbiota is considered as a good indicator of animal health, and plays a vital role in regulating host immune homeostasis and metabolic function (Guarner and Malagelada, 2003 ; Hu, 2017).
statement: 肠道微生物群被认为是动物健康的良好指标，并在调节宿主免疫稳态和代谢功能方面发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群被认为是动物健康的良好指标，并在调节宿主免疫稳态和代谢功能方面发挥重要作用。
text_en: The gut microbiota is considered a good indicator of animal health and plays an important role in regulating host immune homeostasis and metabolic function.
outcome: 健康指示与免疫代谢调节

quote: Therefore, we can conclude that CyHV-2 infection significantly perturbed the gut microbiome, disrupted its’ metabolic functions, and caused the proliferation of the opportunistic pathogen Aeromonas .
statement: CyHV-2感染显著扰乱了肠道微生物群，破坏了其代谢功能，并导致机会性病原体气单胞菌的增殖。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染显著扰乱了肠道微生物群，破坏了其代谢功能，并导致机会性病原体气单胞菌的增殖。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection significantly disrupted the gut microbiota, impaired its metabolic functions, and led to the proliferation of the opportunistic pathogen Aeromonas.
outcome: 肠道健康与病原菌增殖

quote: This study also suggests that modulation of the gut microbiome will open a therapeutic opportunity to control CyHV-2 infection in gibel carp.
statement: 本研究还表明，调节肠道微生物群将为控制鲫鱼中的CyHV-2感染开辟治疗机会。
text_zh: 本研究还表明，调节肠道微生物群将为控制鲫鱼中的CyHV-2感染开辟治疗机会。
text_en: This study also indicates that modulating the gut microbiota will open up therapeutic opportunities for controlling CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp.

quote: However, the disease caused by Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2), also known as the goldfish hematopoietic necrosis virus (GFHNV), limits the sustainable aquaculture of gibel carp (Lu et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2022).
statement: 由鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）引起的疾病限制了鲫鱼的可持续养殖。
text_zh: 由鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）引起的疾病限制了鲫鱼的可持续养殖。
text_en: Disease caused by Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) limits the sustainable farming of crucian carp.

quote: The CyHV-2-infected fish displays lethargic, anorexic, and widespread bleeding in the body, gill, and swim bladder.
statement: 感染CyHV-2的鱼表现出嗜睡、厌食以及身体、鳃和鳔的广泛出血。
text_zh: 感染CyHV-2的鱼表现出嗜睡、厌食以及身体、鳃和鳔的广泛出血。
text_en: Fish infected with CyHV-2 exhibit lethargy, anorexia, and widespread hemorrhage of the body, gills, and swim bladder.

quote: CyHV-2 infection changed midgut metabolites significantly, further affecting metabolisms, such as Trp metabolism.
statement: CyHV-2感染显著改变了中肠代谢物，进而影响了色氨酸代谢等代谢过程。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染显著改变了中肠代谢物，进而影响了色氨酸代谢等代谢过程。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection significantly altered midgut metabolites, thereby affecting metabolic processes such as tryptophan metabolism.

quote: The different microbiota between the control and CyHV-2-infection groups were annotated into 16 functions (Figure S5B).
statement: Control group and CyHV-2 infection group have different gut microbiota, which are annotated to 16 KEGG functions.
text_en: Control group and CyHV-2 infection group have different gut microbiota, which are annotated to 16 KEGG functions.

quote: Results showed that the metabolite profiles between the two groups were separated with 24% and 46% variation explained by PC1 and PC2, respectively (Figure 6).
statement: PLS-DA analysis shows that the midgut metabolite profiles of the control group and the CyHV-2 infection group are significantly separated.
text_en: PLS-DA analysis shows that the midgut metabolite profiles of the control group and the CyHV-2 infection group are significantly separated.

quote: Compared to the control group, the relative abundance of Aeromonas in the CyHV-2-infection group increased from 41.81% to 67.00%, while Cetobacterium decreased from 38.36% to 4.41%
statement: 与对照组相比，CyHV-2感染组中气单胞菌属（Aeromonas）的相对丰度从41.81%增加到67.00%，而梭杆菌属（Cetobacterium）的相对丰度从38.36%减少到4.41%。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，CyHV-2感染组中气单胞菌属（Aeromonas）的相对丰度从41.81%增加到67.00%，而梭杆菌属（Cetobacterium）的相对丰度从38.36%减少到4.41%。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the relative abundance of Aeromonas in the CyHV-2 infection group increased from 41.81% to 67.00%, while the relative abundance of Cetobacterium decreased from 38.36% to 4.41%.

quote: The gut microbiota in the CyHV-2-infection group was clearly separated from the control group, with 69.12% and 22.65% variation explained by PC1 and PC2 at the genus level, respectively
statement: CyHV-2感染组的肠道菌群与对照组明显分离，在属水平上，PC1和PC2分别解释了69.12%和22.65%的变异。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染组的肠道菌群与对照组明显分离，在属水平上，PC1和PC2分别解释了69.12%和22.65%的变异。
text_en: The gut microbiota of the CyHV-2 infection group was significantly separated from that of the control group; at the genus level, PC1 and PC2 explained 69.12% and 22.65% of the variation, respectively.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落结构差异

quote: Therefore, CyHV-2 infection changed the abundance of different classes of bacteria in the midgut of fish.
statement: 因此，CyHV-2感染改变了鱼类中肠不同细菌类别的丰度。
text_zh: 因此，CyHV-2感染改变了鱼类中肠不同细菌类别的丰度。
text_en: Therefore, CyHV-2 infection altered the abundance of different bacterial categories in the fish midgut.

quote: The present results suggested that there was no significant difference in bacterial diversity between CyHV-2-infection and control groups (Table S4).
statement: CyHV-2感染组与对照组之间的细菌多样性没有显著差异。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染组与对照组之间的细菌多样性没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in bacterial diversity between the CyHV-2 infection group and the control group.

quote: Compared to the control group, the relative abundance of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes in the CyHV-2-infection group was significantly increased, while the abundance of Fusobacteria decreased
statement: 与对照组相比，CyHV-2感染组中变形菌门和厚壁菌门的相对丰度显著增加，而梭杆菌门的丰度降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，CyHV-2感染组中变形菌门和厚壁菌门的相对丰度显著增加，而梭杆菌门的丰度降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the relative abundance of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes significantly increased in the CyHV-2 infection group, while the abundance of Fusobacteriota decreased.

quote: In the control group, no CyHV-2 was detected and no clinical symptoms were observed (Figures S1A, B).
statement: 对照组未检测到CyHV-2且未观察到临床症状。
text_zh: 对照组未检测到CyHV-2且未观察到临床症状。
text_en: CyHV-2 was not detected in the control group, and no clinical symptoms were observed.

quote: CM in the CyHV-2-infection (9.7 × 10 7 copies per fish) group was 50%, and no mortality was observed in the PBS control group (Table S2).
statement: 在CyHV-2感染组中累积死亡率(CM)为50%，而PBS对照组未观察到死亡。
text_zh: 在CyHV-2感染组中累积死亡率(CM)为50%，而PBS对照组未观察到死亡。
text_en: In the CyHV-2 infection group, cumulative mortality (CM) was 50%, while no deaths were observed in the PBS control group.

quote: The viral loads in the kidney, spleen, midgut, hindgut, and gill were 4.4 × 10 5 , 3.5 × 10 5 , 3.0 × 10 5 , 1.6 × 10 5 , and 1.3 × 10 5 copies ng -1 DNA, respectively.
Gibel carp could be infected by CyHV-2 through the ‘per-gill’ method in the lab.
statement: 鲫鱼可以通过实验室中的‘鳃部’方法被CyHV-2感染。
text_zh: 鲫鱼可以通过实验室中的‘鳃部’方法被CyHV-2感染。
text_en: Crucian carp can be infected with CyHV-2 via the 'gill' method in the laboratory.

quote: Like natural infection, hemorrhage in the fish skin and bulging eyes was observed at 5 dpi (Figure 1A).
statement: 与自然感染类似，在感染后第5天观察到鱼皮肤出血和眼球突出。
text_zh: 与自然感染类似，在感染后第5天观察到鱼皮肤出血和眼球突出。
text_en: Similar to natural infection, skin hemorrhage and exophthalmos in fish were observed on day 5 post-infection.

quote: Severe hemorrhage was observed in the gills and swim bladder wall (Figures 1B, C) .
statement: 在鳃和鳔壁观察到严重出血。
text_zh: 在鳃和鳔壁观察到严重出血。
text_en: Severe hemorrhage was observed in the gills and swim bladder walls.

quote: Our data demonstrated that CyHV-2 infection changed both the gut microbiome and metabolome, and these two changes were correlated.
statement: CyHV-2感染改变了肠道微生物组和代谢组，且这两种变化之间存在相关性。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染改变了肠道微生物组和代谢组，且这两种变化之间存在相关性。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection altered the gut microbiome and metabolome, and there was a correlation between these two changes.

quote: Each group included triplicates. Death within 14 days was recorded, and CM was calculated.
statement: 每组包含三个重复。记录14天内的死亡情况，并计算累积死亡率（CM）。
text_zh: 每组包含三个重复。记录14天内的死亡情况，并计算累积死亡率（CM）。
text_en: Each group contained three replicates. Mortality was recorded over 14 days, and cumulative mortality (CM) was calculated.

quote: The fish from both the FICZ (1 μg fish -1 , I.P.) group and control group (PBS, 100 μl fish -1) were infected by CyHV-2 through the ‘per-gill’ method as described in part 2.4.
statement: FICZ组（腹腔注射1 μg/鱼）和对照组（腹腔注射100 μl PBS）的鱼均通过‘鳃部’方法感染CyHV-2。
text_zh: FICZ组（腹腔注射1 μg/鱼）和对照组（腹腔注射100 μl PBS）的鱼均通过‘鳃部’方法感染CyHV-2。
text_en: Fish in the FICZ group (intraperitoneal injection of 1 μg/fish) and the control group (intraperitoneal injection of 100 μl PBS) were both infected with CyHV-2 via the 'gill' method.

quote: Compared to the control, the concentrations of the main 24 metabolites were significantly changed in the CyHV-2-infection group.
statement: 与对照组相比，CyHV-2感染组中主要24种代谢物的浓度发生了显著变化。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，CyHV-2感染组中主要24种代谢物的浓度发生了显著变化。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the concentrations of the main 24 metabolites changed significantly in the CyHV-2 infection group.

quote: CyHV-2 and CyHV-3 infections ruin the gut integrity of carps.
statement: CyHV-2和CyHV-3感染会破坏鲤科鱼的肠道完整性。
text_zh: CyHV-2和CyHV-3感染会破坏鲤科鱼的肠道完整性。
text_en: CyHV-2 and CyHV-3 infection disrupts the intestinal integrity of cyprinid fish.

quote: These findings raised the possibility of the direct interaction between CyHV-2 and commensal bacteria (Rong et al., 2017 ; Ran et al., 2021).
statement: 这些发现提出了CyHV-2与共生细菌之间直接相互作用的可能性。
text_zh: 这些发现提出了CyHV-2与共生细菌之间直接相互作用的可能性。
text_en: These findings raise the possibility of a direct interaction between CyHV-2 and symbiotic bacteria.
outcome: 病原体与共生菌相互作用

quote: However, few studies have been conducted to investigate the effect of CyHV-2 infection on the gut microbial ecology by using combined metabolomic and metagenomic analysis. It will hinder the control and prevention development of CyHV-2 infection in gibel carp culture.
statement: 然而，很少有研究通过结合代谢组学和宏基因组学分析来调查CyHV-2感染对肠道微生物生态的影响，这将阻碍鲫鱼养殖中CyHV-2感染控制和预防的发展。
text_zh: 然而，很少有研究通过结合代谢组学和宏基因组学分析来调查CyHV-2感染对肠道微生物生态的影响，这将阻碍鲫鱼养殖中CyHV-2感染控制和预防的发展。
text_en: However, few studies have investigated the impact of CyHV-2 infection on gut microbial ecology by combining metabolomics and metagenomics analysis, which will hinder the development of control and prevention of CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp farming.

quote: Then, the time-dependent number changes of target bacteria associated with CyHV-2 infection were analyzed through the culture method.
statement: 然后，通过培养方法分析了与CyHV-2感染相关的目标细菌数量随时间的变化。
text_zh: 然后，通过培养方法分析了与CyHV-2感染相关的目标细菌数量随时间的变化。
text_en: Then, the changes in the number of target bacteria associated with CyHV-2 infection over time were analyzed by culture methods.
intervention_record: 培养法监测气单胞菌丰度

quote: Furthermore, tryptophan (Trp) metabolism was taken as one of the examples to prove the correlation between CyHV-2 infection and the metabolites since 1) the changes of microbiota and metabolites in the fish midgut post-CyHV-2 infection in this study had been annotated to Trp metabolism;
statement: 此外，色氨酸（Trp）代谢被作为例子之一，以证明CyHV-2感染与代谢物之间的相关性，因为本研究中感染CyHV-2后鱼中后肠微生物群和代谢物的变化已被注释为与Trp代谢相关。
text_zh: 此外，色氨酸（Trp）代谢被作为例子之一，以证明CyHV-2感染与代谢物之间的相关性，因为本研究中感染CyHV-2后鱼中后肠微生物群和代谢物的变化已被注释为与Trp代谢相关。
text_en: In addition, tryptophan (Trp) metabolism was used as one example to demonstrate the correlation between CyHV-2 infection and metabolites, because the changes in the hindgut microbiota and metabolites of fish after CyHV-2 infection in this study have been annotated as related to Trp metabolism.

quote: Aeromonas presented a closely positive association with the viral infection (Figure 5).
statement: 气单胞菌属（Aeromonas）与病毒感染呈现密切的正相关关系。
text_zh: 气单胞菌属（Aeromonas）与病毒感染呈现密切的正相关关系。
text_en: The genus Aeromonas shows a close positive correlation with viral infection.
outcome: 疾病与微生物群落关系

quote: Aeromonas accounted for 41.81% in the control group and 67.00% in the CyHV-2-infection group (Figure 3B).
statement: 对照组中气单胞菌属占41.81%，而CyHV-2感染组中占67.00%。
text_zh: 对照组中气单胞菌属占41.81%，而CyHV-2感染组中占67.00%。
text_en: In the control group, Aeromonas accounted for 41.81%, while in the CyHV-2 infected group it accounted for 67.00%.

quote: A time-dependent abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut of gibel carp post-CyHV-2 infection by the culture method increased from 3.8 × 10 4 CFU g -1 midgut at 0 dpi to 6.4 × 10 5 CFU g -1 midgut at 1 dpi, 2.8 × 10 6 CFU g -1 midgut at 4 dpi, and 7.6 × 10 7 CFU g -1 midgut at 5 dpi, respectively.
statement: 通过培养方法测得，CyHV-2感染后鲫鱼中肠内气单胞菌属的丰度随时间增加，从0天时的3.8 × 10^4 CFU/g增加到5天时的7.6 × 10^7 CFU/g。
text_zh: 通过培养方法测得，CyHV-2感染后鲫鱼中肠内气单胞菌属的丰度随时间增加，从0天时的3.8 × 10^4 CFU/g增加到5天时的7.6 × 10^7 CFU/g。
text_en: Measured by culture methods, the abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut of crucian carp after CyHV-2 infection increased over time, from 3.8 × 10^4 CFU/g at day 0 to 7.6 × 10^7 CFU/g at day 5.

quote: There was no significant difference in Aeromonas (less than 8 CFU ml -1 water) in culture water between the two groups during the whole challenge test.
statement: 在整个攻击试验期间，两组养殖水体中的气单胞菌属数量（低于8 CFU/ml）没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在整个攻击试验期间，两组养殖水体中的气单胞菌属数量（低于8 CFU/ml）没有显著差异。
text_en: Throughout the entire challenge test, there was no significant difference in the number of Aeromonas spp. (below 8 CFU/ml) in the aquaculture water of both groups.

quote: These results illustrated that CyHV-2 infection increased the relative abundance of Aeromonas and decreased Cetobacterium.
statement: 这些结果表明，CyHV-2感染增加了气单胞菌属的相对丰度并降低了梭杆菌属（Cetobacterium）的丰度。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，CyHV-2感染增加了气单胞菌属的相对丰度并降低了梭杆菌属（Cetobacterium）的丰度。
text_en: These results indicate that CyHV-2 infection increased the relative abundance of Aeromonas and decreased the abundance of Cetobacterium.
outcome: 疾病对肠道菌群的影响

quote: Compared to the PBS injection group, CyHV-2-infection group, and ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ group, FICZ stimulation at 4 and 5 dpi increased the number of total culturable bacteria by approximately two folds significantly.
statement: 与PBS注射组、CyHV-2感染组和‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组相比，在感染后第4和5天进行FICZ刺激使可培养细菌总数显著增加了约两倍。
text_zh: 与PBS注射组、CyHV-2感染组和‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组相比，在感染后第4和5天进行FICZ刺激使可培养细菌总数显著增加了约两倍。
text_en: Compared with the PBS injection group, the CyHV-2 infection group, and the 'FICZ+CyHV-2' group, FICZ stimulation on days 4 and 5 post-infection significantly increased the total number of cultivable bacteria by about two-fold.

quote: There was no significant difference among the PBS injection group, CyHV-2-infection group, and ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’-infection group (Figure 11A).
statement: PBS注射组、CyHV-2感染组和‘FICZ+CyHV-2’感染组之间没有显著差异。
text_zh: PBS注射组、CyHV-2感染组和‘FICZ+CyHV-2’感染组之间没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference between the PBS injection group, the CyHV-2 infection group, and the 'FICZ+CyHV-2' infection group.

quote: However, compared to PBS injection group and FICZ injection group, the number of Aeromonas spp. in the CyHV-2-infection group and ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’- infection group from 1 to 7 dpi increased significantly.
statement: 然而，与PBS注射组和FICZ注射组相比，CyHV-2感染组和‘FICZ+CyHV-2’感染组中气单胞菌属的数量在感染后1至7天内显著增加。
text_zh: 然而，与PBS注射组和FICZ注射组相比，CyHV-2感染组和‘FICZ+CyHV-2’感染组中气单胞菌属的数量在感染后1至7天内显著增加。
text_en: However, compared to the PBS injection group and the FICZ injection group, the number of Aeromonas increased significantly in the CyHV-2 infection group and the 'FICZ+CyHV-2' infection group within 1 to 7 days post-infection.

quote: The number of Aeromonas spp. in the CyHV-2-infection group was significantly higher than that in the ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ infection group from 1 to 7 dpi.
statement: 从感染后1到7天，CyHV-2感染组中气单胞菌属的数量显著高于‘FICZ+CyHV-2’感染组。
text_zh: 从感染后1到7天，CyHV-2感染组中气单胞菌属的数量显著高于‘FICZ+CyHV-2’感染组。
text_en: From 1 to 7 days post-infection, the number of Aeromonas in the CyHV-2 infection group was significantly higher than that in the 'FICZ+CyHV-2' infection group.

quote: FICZ injection could inhibit the replication of Aeromonas spp. in the midgut of fish post-CyHV-2 infection (Figure 11B).
statement: FICZ注射可以抑制CyHV-2感染后鱼中肠内气单胞菌属的复制。
text_zh: FICZ注射可以抑制CyHV-2感染后鱼中肠内气单胞菌属的复制。
text_en: FICZ injection can inhibit the replication of Aeromonas in the midgut of fish after CyHV-2 infection.

quote: Compared to the ‘PBS+CyHV-2’-infection group, the viral replication in the ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ group was slower, suggesting that higher AhR expression inhibited CyHV-2 replication in vivo .
statement: 与PBS+CyHV-2感染组相比，FICZ+CyHV-2组的病毒复制较慢，表明较高的AhR表达在体内抑制了CyHV-2的复制。
text_zh: 与PBS+CyHV-2感染组相比，FICZ+CyHV-2组的病毒复制较慢，表明较高的AhR表达在体内抑制了CyHV-2的复制。
text_en: Compared with the PBS+CyHV-2 infection group, viral replication was slower in the FICZ+CyHV-2 group, indicating that higher AhR expression inhibited CyHV-2 replication in vivo.

quote: The viral load in the ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ group at 6 hpi (6.9 × 10 3 copies ng -1 DNA) and 120 hpi (2.3 × 10 4 copies ng -1 DNA) was lower than that in the ‘PBS+CyHV-2’ group, which were 1.4 × 10 4 copies ng -1 DNA at 6 hpi and 5.5 × 10 4 copies ng -1 DNA at 120 hpi, respectively (Figure 8D).
statement: FICZ+CyHV-2组在感染后6小时和120小时的病毒载量低于PBS+CyHV-2组。
text_zh: FICZ+CyHV-2组在感染后6小时和120小时的病毒载量低于PBS+CyHV-2组。
text_en: The viral load in the FICZ+CyHV-2 group was lower than that in the PBS+CyHV-2 group at 6 hours and 120 hours post-infection.

quote: Compared to the ‘PBS+CyHV-2’ infection group, the CM of fish post-CyHV-2 infection in the ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ group was much lower.
statement: 与‘PBS+CyHV-2’感染组相比，‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组中鱼在CyHV-2感染后的累积死亡率显著降低。
text_zh: 与‘PBS+CyHV-2’感染组相比，‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组中鱼在CyHV-2感染后的累积死亡率显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the 'PBS+CyHV-2' infection group, the cumulative mortality of fish in the 'FICZ+CyHV-2' group was significantly reduced after CyHV-2 infection.

quote: CM in the ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ group at the viral concentrations of 2.4 × 10 7 and 9.7×10 6 copies μl -1 was 41.7% and 33.3%, respectively. They were 83.8% and 58.3% in the ‘PBS+CyHV-2’ group.
statement: 在病毒浓度为2.4 × 10^7和9.7×10^6 copies/μl时，‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组的累积死亡率分别为41.7%和33.3%，而‘PBS+CyHV-2’组分别为83.8%和58.3%。
text_en: 在病毒浓度为2.4 × 10^7和9.7×10^6 copies/μl时，‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组的累积死亡率分别为41.7%和33.3%，而‘PBS+CyHV-2’组分别为83.8%和58.3%。

quote: The fish in the ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’ group died later than that in the ‘PBS+CyHV-2’ group.
statement: ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组中的鱼比‘PBS+CyHV-2’组中的鱼死亡时间更晚。
text_zh: ‘FICZ+CyHV-2’组中的鱼比‘PBS+CyHV-2’组中的鱼死亡时间更晚。
text_en: Fish in the 'FICZ+CyHV-2' group died later than fish in the 'PBS+CyHV-2' group.

quote: At 6, 12, 24, 48, 72, and 120 hpi, the kidney from ‘FICZ +CyHV-2-infected’ fish and ‘PBS +CyHV-2-infected’ fish was sampled, and viral load was quantified by qPCR as described in part 2.3.
statement: 在感染后6、12、24、48、72和120小时，采集‘FICZ+CyHV-2感染’组和‘PBS+CyHV-2感染’组鱼的肾脏，并通过qPCR定量病毒载量。
text_zh: 在感染后6、12、24、48、72和120小时，采集‘FICZ+CyHV-2感染’组和‘PBS+CyHV-2感染’组鱼的肾脏，并通过qPCR定量病毒载量。
text_en: At 6, 12, 24, 48, 72 and 120 hours post-infection, kidneys were collected from fish in the 'FICZ+CyHV-2 infection' group and the 'PBS+CyHV-2 infection' group, and viral load was quantified by qPCR.
intervention: Kidney sampling and qPCR viral load
intervention_record: 肾脏采样与qPCR病毒载量检测

quote: However, in the CyHV-2-infection group, the concentration decreased from 5.38 pM (0 hpi) to 3.77 pM (120 hpi)
statement: 在CyHV-2感染组中，AhR浓度从感染后0小时的5.38 pM下降到120小时的3.77 pM。
text_zh: 在CyHV-2感染组中，AhR浓度从感染后0小时的5.38 pM下降到120小时的3.77 pM。
text_en: In the CyHV-2 infection group, AhR concentration decreased from 5.38 pM at 0 hours post-infection to 3.77 pM at 120 hours.
outcome: 健康状态（病毒感染的生理影响）

quote: The transcriptional levels of cytokines JAK , IFN-γ , ISG15 , MX1 , IL-4 , Gata3 , and T-Bet1 were upregulated significantly by 9.75-fold, 9.92-fold, 7.05-fold, 5.56-fold, 2.03-fold, 4.14-fold, and 2.75-fold, respectively.
statement: 细胞因子JAK、IFN-γ、ISG15、MX1、IL-4、Gata3和T-Bet1的转录水平分别显著上调了9.75倍、9.92倍、7.05倍、5.56倍、2.03倍、4.14倍和2.75倍。
text_zh: 细胞因子JAK、IFN-γ、ISG15、MX1、IL-4、Gata3和T-Bet1的转录水平分别显著上调了9.75倍、9.92倍、7.05倍、5.56倍、2.03倍、4.14倍和2.75倍。
text_en: The transcription levels of cytokines JAK, IFN-γ, ISG15, MX1, IL-4, Gata3 and T-Bet1 were significantly upregulated by 9.75-fold, 9.92-fold, 7.05-fold, 5.56-fold, 2.03-fold, 4.14-fold and 2.75-fold, respectively.
outcome: 免疫反应（细胞因子表达）

quote: The gut metabolic disorders were observed in the CyHV-2-infected fish.
statement: 在感染CyHV-2的鱼中观察到肠道代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 在感染CyHV-2的鱼中观察到肠道代谢紊乱。
text_en: Intestinal metabolic disorders were observed in fish infected with CyHV-2.

quote: A disturbance in the functional equilibrium can lead to changes in the microbial diversity and abundance of certain bacteria, which are beneficial or harmful to fish (Liu et al., 2013 ; Ling et al., 2014 ; Lukens et al., 2014).
statement: 功能平衡的扰动会导致微生物多样性和某些细菌丰度的变化，这些变化对鱼类有益或有害。
text_zh: 功能平衡的扰动会导致微生物多样性和某些细菌丰度的变化，这些变化对鱼类有益或有害。
text_en: Perturbations of functional balance lead to changes in microbial diversity and the abundance of certain bacteria, which are beneficial or harmful to fish.

quote: Thus, we used a laboratory infection model instead of naturally infected fish to study the effect of CyHV-2 infection on the gut microbiota and microbiome.
statement: 研究使用实验室感染模型而非自然感染的鱼来研究CyHV-2感染对肠道菌群和微生物组的影响。
text_zh: 研究使用实验室感染模型而非自然感染的鱼来研究CyHV-2感染对肠道菌群和微生物组的影响。
text_en: The study used a laboratory infection model rather than naturally infected fish to investigate the effects of CyHV-2 infection on gut microbiota and the microbiome.

quote: After acclimation, the gut microbiota is more stable (Chen et al., 2021).
statement: 经过驯化后，肠道菌群更加稳定。
text_zh: 经过驯化后，肠道菌群更加稳定。
text_en: After acclimation, the gut microbiota is more stable.

quote: The absence of gut microbiota in fish may lead to epithelial cell dysfunction and weaker immune responses (Wang et al., 2018).
statement: 鱼类肠道微生物群的缺失可能导致上皮细胞功能障碍和免疫反应减弱。
text_zh: 鱼类肠道微生物群的缺失可能导致上皮细胞功能障碍和免疫反应减弱。
text_en: The absence of gut microbiota in fish may lead to epithelial cell dysfunction and weakened immune responses.

quote: The present results showed (1) gut microbiota dysbiosis, especially the relative abundance increment of Aeromonas and decrement of Cetobacterium ; (2) metabolome alternation regarding amino acid metabolism, carbohydrate metabolism, and lipid metabolism, especially Trp metabolism ; (3) the strong correlation between gut microbiota and metabolite profiles; and (4) the interference of viral infection through modulating gut ecology.
statement: 本研究表明CyHV-2感染导致肠道菌群失调（气单胞菌增加，梭杆菌减少）、代谢组改变以及通过调节肠道生态干扰病毒感染。
text_zh: 本研究表明CyHV-2感染导致肠道菌群失调（气单胞菌增加，梭杆菌减少）、代谢组改变以及通过调节肠道生态干扰病毒感染。
text_en: This study shows that CyHV-2 infection leads to gut microbiota dysbiosis (increased Aeromonas, decreased Fusobacterium), metabolomic changes, and interference with viral infection by modulating the gut ecology.
outcome: 疾病状态下的肠道微生态与代谢

quote: High SMR individuals showed a higher growth rate when fed to satiation, but this advantage of SMR did not exist in food-restricted fish.
statement: 高标准代谢率个体在饱食条件下表现出更高的生长率，但在食物限制条件下这种优势不存在。
text_zh: 高标准代谢率个体在饱食条件下表现出更高的生长率，但在食物限制条件下这种优势不存在。
text_en: Individuals with high standard metabolic rates exhibit higher growth rates under satiation conditions, but this advantage does not exist under food restriction conditions.

quote: High SMR individuals experienced more mass loss during food deprivation as compared to low SMR individuals.
statement: 与低标准代谢率个体相比，高标准代谢率个体在禁食期间经历了更多的体重损失。
text_zh: 与低标准代谢率个体相比，高标准代谢率个体在禁食期间经历了更多的体重损失。
text_en: Compared to individuals with low standard metabolic rate, individuals with high standard metabolic rate experienced more weight loss during fasting.

quote: After the 4 week acclimation period, SMR of all fish was estimated by measuring their oxygen uptake after 48 h of fasting (Table 1).
statement: 在4周适应期后，通过测量禁食48小时后的氧气摄取量来估算所有鱼的静息代谢率（SMR）。
text_zh: 在4周适应期后，通过测量禁食48小时后的氧气摄取量来估算所有鱼的静息代谢率（SMR）。
text_en: After a 4-week adaptation period, the standard metabolic rate (SMR) of all fish was estimated by measuring oxygen uptake after 48 hours of fasting.

quote: To avoid the influence of dominance hierarchies and competition for food, fish were individually raised in 80 separated compartments (length×width×height=17×10×15 cm) in two independent cycling tank systems
statement: 为了避免优势等级和食物竞争的影响，鱼被单独饲养在两个独立循环水箱系统中的80个分隔隔间内。
text_zh: 为了避免优势等级和食物竞争的影响，鱼被单独饲养在两个独立循环水箱系统中的80个分隔隔间内。
text_en: To avoid the effects of dominance hierarchy and food competition, fish were individually housed in 80 compartments within two independent recirculating tank systems.

quote: No differences in feeding efficiency (FE) were detected between the HS and LS group, but the LR group had a larger FE (78.5%) than the HR group (56.4%)
statement: 高SMR饱食组（HS）与低SMR饱食组（LS）之间的摄食效率无显著差异，但低SMR限制喂食组（LR）的摄食效率（78.5%）高于高SMR限制喂食组（HR）（56.4%）。
text_zh: 高SMR饱食组（HS）与低SMR饱食组（LS）之间的摄食效率无显著差异，但低SMR限制喂食组（LR）的摄食效率（78.5%）高于高SMR限制喂食组（HR）（56.4%）。
text_en: There was no significant difference in feeding efficiency between the high SMR satiated group (HS) and the low SMR satiated group (LS), but the feeding efficiency of the low SMR restricted feeding group (LR) (78.5%) was higher than that of the high SMR restricted feeding group (HR) (56.4%).
intervention: Standard metabolic rate and food availability
intervention_record: 标准代谢率与食物可得性组合

quote: a positive and negative relationship was found between rSMR and FE in the satiation group and restricted group, respectively
statement: 在饱食组和限制饲喂组中，相对标准代谢率（rSMR）与饲料效率（FE）分别呈正相关和负相关。
text_zh: 在饱食组和限制饲喂组中，相对标准代谢率（rSMR）与饲料效率（FE）分别呈正相关和负相关。
text_en: In the satiation and restricted feeding groups, relative standard metabolic rate (rSMR) was positively and negatively correlated with feed efficiency (FE), respectively.

quote: The high SMR group had a greater rate of mass loss during food deprivation as compared to the lower SMR group (two-tailed t -test, t =2.191, P =0.032).
statement: 高静息代谢率组在禁食期间的体重下降速率高于低静息代谢率组。
text_zh: 高静息代谢率组在禁食期间的体重下降速率高于低静息代谢率组。
text_en: The group with high resting metabolic rate had a higher rate of weight loss during fasting than the group with low resting metabolic rate.

quote: These actionable studies will probably provide an excellent immunotherapeutic intervention to control carp diseases and thus advance the sustainable culture.
statement: 这些可操作的研究可能为控制鲤鱼疾病提供极好的免疫治疗干预措施，从而促进可持续养殖。
text_zh: 这些可操作的研究可能为控制鲤鱼疾病提供极好的免疫治疗干预措施，从而促进可持续养殖。
text_en: These actionable studies may provide excellent immunotherapeutic intervention measures for controlling carp diseases, thereby promoting sustainable aquaculture.
outcome: 疾病控制与养殖可持续性

quote: Our results supported that CyHV-2 infection–induced changes in the midgut, bacterial community structure disturbed the metabolic functions of the gut microbiome, and the viral infection process could be interrupted through the modulation of gut microecology.
statement: 研究结果支持CyHV-2感染诱导的中肠细菌群落结构变化扰乱了肠道微生物组的代谢功能，且病毒感染的过程可以通过调节肠道微生态来中断。
text_zh: 研究结果支持CyHV-2感染诱导的中肠细菌群落结构变化扰乱了肠道微生物组的代谢功能，且病毒感染的过程可以通过调节肠道微生态来中断。
text_en: The results support that the changes in the bacterial community structure of the midgut induced by CyHV-2 infection disrupted the metabolic functions of the gut microbiome, and the process of viral infection can be interrupted by regulating the gut microecology.
outcome: 病毒感染进程与肠道菌群平衡

quote: Gibel carp can be artificially infected by CyHV-2 through the ‘per-gill’ method.
statement: 鲫鱼可以通过‘经鳃’方法人工感染CyHV-2。
text_zh: 鲫鱼可以通过‘经鳃’方法人工感染CyHV-2。
text_en: Crucian carp can be artificially infected with CyHV-2 via the 'gill' method.

quote: Like natural infection, the typical clinical syndromes of hemorrhagic gills and the swim bladder were observed post-CyHV-2 infection through the ‘per-gill’ method, and CyHV-2 could be quantified in different inner organs.
statement: 与自然感染类似，通过‘经鳃’方法感染CyHV-2后观察到出血性鳃和鳔的典型临床综合征，且可在不同内脏器官中定量检测CyHV-2。
text_zh: 与自然感染类似，通过‘经鳃’方法感染CyHV-2后观察到出血性鳃和鳔的典型临床综合征，且可在不同内脏器官中定量检测CyHV-2。
text_en: Similar to natural infection, the typical clinical syndrome of hemorrhagic gills and swim bladder was observed after CyHV-2 infection via the 'gill' method, and CyHV-2 could be quantified in different internal organs.

quote: Until now, there is no effective method to control this disease, although some studies on a vaccine are undergoing in the lab (Takafumi and Yukio, 2015 ; Yan et al., 2020).
statement: 目前尚无有效控制该疾病的方法，尽管实验室正在进行一些疫苗研究。
text_zh: 目前尚无有效控制该疾病的方法，尽管实验室正在进行一些疫苗研究。
text_en: There is currently no effective method to control this disease, although some vaccine research is being conducted in laboratories.

quote: Early prevention before disease outbreaks becomes more important to control this epidemic disease.
statement: 在疾病爆发前的早期预防对于控制这种流行病变得更加重要。
text_zh: 在疾病爆发前的早期预防对于控制这种流行病变得更加重要。
text_en: Early prevention before the disease outbreak is more important for controlling this epidemic.

quote: the decreased FE of low SMR individuals in the satiation treatment may be due to low digestive and assimilative capacities when food is eaten to excess
statement: 在饱食处理中，低标准代谢率个体的摄食效率降低可能归因于过量进食时较低的消化和同化能力。
text_zh: 在饱食处理中，低标准代谢率个体的摄食效率降低可能归因于过量进食时较低的消化和同化能力。
text_en: In the satiation treatment, the reduced feeding efficiency of individuals with low standard metabolic rate may be attributed to lower digestion and assimilation capacity during overfeeding.

quote: the higher FE of low SMR individuals under the restricted food condition may be due to their low maintenance metabolism (Burton et al., 2011): nutrients from a given meal are more likely to be allocated to the somatic growth rather than idling costs in low SMR individuals
statement: 在限食条件下，低标准代谢率个体较高的摄食效率可能归因于其较低的基础代谢，使得营养更倾向于分配给体细胞生长而非维持成本。
text_zh: 在限食条件下，低标准代谢率个体较高的摄食效率可能归因于其较低的基础代谢，使得营养更倾向于分配给体细胞生长而非维持成本。
text_en: Under feed restriction, the higher feeding efficiency of individuals with low standard metabolic rate may be attributed to their lower basal metabolism, resulting in nutrients being more allocated to somatic growth rather than maintenance costs.

quote: During food deprivation, the rate of mass loss in high SMR individuals was greater than that of low SMR individuals, indicating that an individual with relatively low SMR possesses a higher starvation tolerance.
statement: 在禁食期间，高标准代谢率个体的体重损失速率大于低标准代谢率个体，表明相对较低的标准代谢率个体具有更高的耐饥饿能力。
text_zh: 在禁食期间，高标准代谢率个体的体重损失速率大于低标准代谢率个体，表明相对较低的标准代谢率个体具有更高的耐饥饿能力。
text_en: During fasting, individuals with high standard metabolic rates lost weight at a faster rate than those with low standard metabolic rates, indicating that individuals with relatively lower standard metabolic rates have greater starvation tolerance.

quote: However, such a growth advantage did not exist for high SMR individuals under a restricted diet.
statement: 然而，在限制饮食条件下，高静息代谢率个体的这种生长优势并不存在。
text_zh: 然而，在限制饮食条件下，高静息代谢率个体的这种生长优势并不存在。
text_en: However, under dietary restriction conditions, this growth advantage of individuals with high resting metabolic rate does not exist.

quote: Sugar availability influences the microbiota composition and expansion of bacterial pathogens (Lustri et al., 2017).
statement: The availability of sugars affects the composition of the microbiota and the expansion of bacterial pathogens.
text_en: The availability of sugars affects the composition of the microbiota and the expansion of bacterial pathogens.

quote: During periods of eutrophication during the summer, for example, Atlantic croaker (Micropagonias undulates) (Powers et al., 2005), or while overwintering, fishes can often go with little or no food for days or weeks at a time (Auer et al., 2016).
statement: 在夏季富营养化期间或越冬时，鱼类经常会在数天至数周内处于极少或无食物的状态。
text_zh: 在夏季富营养化期间或越冬时，鱼类经常会在数天至数周内处于极少或无食物的状态。
text_en: During summer eutrophication or overwintering, fish are often in a state of little or no food for days to weeks.

quote: The ability to tolerate reduced food availability (using mass-loss as an index for vulnerability) varies greatly not only among species (McCue, 2010) but also within species (Dupont-Prinet et al., 2010 ; Killen et al., 2011 ; McKenzie et al., 2014 ; Auer et al., 2015a , b).
statement: 耐受食物减少的能力（以体重损失作为脆弱性指标）不仅在物种间差异很大，在物种内部也存在巨大差异。
text_zh: 耐受食物减少的能力（以体重损失作为脆弱性指标）不仅在物种间差异很大，在物种内部也存在巨大差异。
text_en: The ability to tolerate reduced food intake (with weight loss as a vulnerability indicator) varies greatly not only between species but also within species.
outcome: 对食物短缺的耐受性/体重损失

quote: In addition, studies on Wuchang bream (Megalobrama amblycephala) and gibel carp (Carassius gibelio) showed that emodin can mediate the Nrf2/Keap1 signaling pathway to improve the body’s antioxidant capacity and protect it from oxidative stress [ 13 , 14 ].
statement: 在大鳞鲂和银鲫的研究中，大黄素可以通过介导Nrf2/Keap1信号通路来提高机体的抗氧化能力并保护其免受氧化应激。
text_zh: 在大鳞鲂和银鲫的研究中，大黄素可以通过介导Nrf2/Keap1信号通路来提高机体的抗氧化能力并保护其免受氧化应激。
text_en: In studies on Megalobrama amblycephala and Carassius gibelio, emodin can improve the body's antioxidant capacity and protect it from oxidative stress by mediating the Nrf2/Keap1 signaling pathway.

population.species: Wuchang bream (Megalobrama amblycephala), gibel carp (Carassius gibelio)

outcome: 抗氧化能力与氧化应激保护

quote: During the feeding phase, specific growth rate (SGR) was higher in the HS group than the LS group (high SMR individuals with satiation food, HS group; low SMR individuals with satiation food, LS group) but did not differ between the HR and LR group (high SMR individuals with restricted food, HR group; low SMR individuals with restricted food, LR group)
statement: 在投喂阶段，高标准代谢率（SMR）且饱食组（HS）的特定生长率（SGR）高于低SMR且饱食组（LS），但在高SMR限制喂食组（HR）和低SMR限制喂食组（LR）之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 在投喂阶段，高标准代谢率（SMR）且饱食组（HS）的特定生长率（SGR）高于低SMR且饱食组（LS），但在高SMR限制喂食组（HR）和低SMR限制喂食组（LR）之间无显著差异。
text_en: During the feeding phase, the specific growth rate (SGR) of the high standard metabolic rate (SMR) and fed group (HS) was higher than that of the low SMR and fed group (LS), but there was no significant difference between the high SMR restricted feeding group (HR) and the low SMR restricted feeding group (LR).
intervention: Standard metabolic rate and food availability
intervention_record: 标准代谢率与食物可得性组合

quote: A positive relationship among individuals was found between residual SMR (rSMR) and SGR under satiated ration treatment (Fig. 2 A, r =0.417, P =0.013), but not in the restricted ration treatment (Fig. 2 A, r =−0.288, P =0.088).
statement: 在饱食处理下，个体间剩余标准代谢率（rSMR）与特定生长率（SGR）呈正相关，但在限制喂食处理下这种相关性不显著。
text_zh: 在饱食处理下，个体间剩余标准代谢率（rSMR）与特定生长率（SGR）呈正相关，但在限制喂食处理下这种相关性不显著。
text_en: Under the satiation treatment, individual residual standard metabolic rate (rSMR) was positively correlated with specific growth rate (SGR), but this correlation was not significant under the restricted feeding treatment.
intervention: Standard metabolic rate and food availability
intervention_record: 标准代谢率与食物可得性组合

quote: No differences in food intake (FI) were found between high and low SMR individuals within either the satiation group or the restricted group
statement: 无论是在饱食组还是限制喂食组内，高SMR个体与低SMR个体之间的摄食量均无显著差异。
text_zh: 无论是在饱食组还是限制喂食组内，高SMR个体与低SMR个体之间的摄食量均无显著差异。
text_en: Within both the satiated group and the restricted feeding group, there was no significant difference in feed intake between individuals with high SMR and those with low SMR.

quote: CyHV-2 infection reduced AhR concentration in the midgut (Figure 8A) and serum (data not shown)
statement: CyHV-2感染降低了中肠和血清中的AhR浓度。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染降低了中肠和血清中的AhR浓度。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection reduced AhR concentrations in the midgut and serum.

quote: higher AhR expression reduced the relative abundance of Aeromonas spp. in the midgut of fish post-CyHV-2 infection;
statement: 较高的AhR表达降低了CyHV-2感染后鱼中肠气单胞菌属的相对丰度。
text_zh: 较高的AhR表达降低了CyHV-2感染后鱼中肠气单胞菌属的相对丰度。
text_en: Higher AhR expression reduced the relative abundance of Aeromonas in the fish midgut after CyHV-2 infection.

quote: higher AhR expression reduced the 14-day CM of fish post-CyHV-2 infection and inhibited viral replication in vivo .
statement: 较高的AhR表达降低了CyHV-2感染后鱼的14天累积死亡率并抑制了体内病毒复制。
text_zh: 较高的AhR表达降低了CyHV-2感染后鱼的14天累积死亡率并抑制了体内病毒复制。
text_en: Higher AhR expression reduced the 14-day cumulative mortality of fish after CyHV-2 infection and inhibited viral replication in vivo.

quote: CyHV-2 infection changed the gut microbiota of fish.
statement: CyHV-2感染改变了鱼类的肠道微生物群。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染改变了鱼类的肠道微生物群。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection altered the gut microbiota of fish.

quote: The abundance of genera Aeromonas , Pseudomonas , and Flavobacterium were significantly increased in the CyHV-2-infected fish.
statement: 在CyHV-2感染的鱼类中，气单胞菌属、假单胞菌属和黄杆菌属的丰度显著增加。
text_zh: 在CyHV-2感染的鱼类中，气单胞菌属、假单胞菌属和黄杆菌属的丰度显著增加。
text_en: In fish infected with CyHV-2, the abundance of Aeromonas, Pseudomonas, and Flavobacterium significantly increased.

quote: Particularly, the relative abundance of Aeromonas in the CyHV-2-infected fish increased significantly from 48.74% to 67.00%, consistent with reports in crucian carp (C. carassius) (Caruso et al., 2017).
statement: 特别是，CyHV-2感染鱼类中气单胞菌的相对丰度从48.74%显著增加到67.00%，这与关于鲫鱼（C. carassius）的报告一致。
text_zh: 特别是，CyHV-2感染鱼类中气单胞菌的相对丰度从48.74%显著增加到67.00%，这与关于鲫鱼（C. carassius）的报告一致。
text_en: In particular, the relative abundance of Aeromonas in fish infected with CyHV-2 increased significantly from 48.74% to 67.00%, which is consistent with reports on crucian carp (C. carassius).

quote: Accordingly, a time-dependent abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut of gibel carp increased along with the CyHV-2 infection progress.
statement: 因此，银鲫中肠内气单胞菌的丰度随CyHV-2感染进程呈时间依赖性增加。
text_zh: 因此，银鲫中肠内气单胞菌的丰度随CyHV-2感染进程呈时间依赖性增加。
text_en: Therefore, the abundance of Aeromonas in the midgut of gibel carp increased in a time-dependent manner with CyHV-2 infection progression.
outcome: 中肠气单胞菌丰度变化

quote: This study suggests that the abundance of Aeromonas could be attractively monitored during the disease development progress.
statement: 本研究表明，气单胞菌的丰度可以在疾病发展过程中进行有吸引力的监测。
text_zh: 本研究表明，气单胞菌的丰度可以在疾病发展过程中进行有吸引力的监测。
text_en: This study shows that the abundance of Aeromonas can be monitored attractively during disease development.
intervention_record: 培养法监测气单胞菌丰度

quote: To avoid the influence of digestion on measurements of SMR, fish were fasted for 48 h prior to being placed into respirometry chambers, by which time fish had evacuated their guts (Fu et al., 2009 ; Li et al., 2015).
statement: 为避免消化对标准代谢率（SMR）测量的影响，鱼在放入呼吸测定室前禁食48小时，此时鱼已排空肠道。
text_zh: 为避免消化对标准代谢率（SMR）测量的影响，鱼在放入呼吸测定室前禁食48小时，此时鱼已排空肠道。
text_en: To avoid the effect of digestion on standard metabolic rate (SMR) measurements, fish were fasted for 48 hours before being placed in the respirometry chamber, at which point their guts were empty.
outcome: 测量准确性与动物处理

quote: The oxygen content of the water was kept to saturation using an air pump.
statement: 使用气泵将储水箱中的水氧含量保持在饱和状态。
text_zh: 使用气泵将储水箱中的水氧含量保持在饱和状态。
text_en: Use an air pump to keep the oxygen content of the water in the storage tank at saturation.

quote: Water from the outlet of each chamber passed through a biological filter and then returned to the reservoir tank.
statement: 每个呼吸测定室出口的水经过生物过滤器后返回储水箱。
text_zh: 每个呼吸测定室出口的水经过生物过滤器后返回储水箱。
text_en: The water from the outlet of each respirometry chamber passes through a biological filter before returning to the reservoir tank.

quote: However, animals with a higher SMR may experience costs under stressful environments (i.e. food shortage) due to their higher maintenance metabolism
statement: 然而，由于较高的维持代谢，具有较高标准代谢率（SMR）的动物在压力环境（即食物短缺）下可能会经历成本增加。
text_zh: 然而，由于较高的维持代谢，具有较高标准代谢率（SMR）的动物在压力环境（即食物短缺）下可能会经历成本增加。
text_en: However, due to higher maintenance metabolism, animals with a higher standard metabolic rate (SMR) may experience increased costs under stressful environments (i.e., food shortage).
outcome: 应激环境下的代谢成本

quote: During each feeding, fish in the satiation treatment were fed to excess and uneaten pellets were collected and counted to calculate the feed intake.
statement: 在饱食处理中，鱼被过量喂食，通过收集和计数未食用的颗粒来计算摄食量。
text_zh: 在饱食处理中，鱼被过量喂食，通过收集和计数未食用的颗粒来计算摄食量。
text_en: In the satiation treatment, fish were fed ad libitum, and feed intake was calculated by collecting and counting uneaten pellets.

quote: The restricted ration treatment was fed one half of the mean diet pellets of the satiation group.
statement: 限饲处理组的投喂量为饱食组平均饲料颗粒量的一半。
text_zh: 限饲处理组的投喂量为饱食组平均饲料颗粒量的一半。
text_en: The feeding amount in the restricted feeding group was half of the average feed pellet amount in the satiation group.

quote: Fish from the restricted group consumed all food provided during each feeding period.
statement: 限饲组的鱼在每个喂食期间消耗了所有提供的食物。
text_zh: 限饲组的鱼在每个喂食期间消耗了所有提供的食物。
text_en: Fish in the restricted feeding group consumed all provided food during each feeding period.

quote: One hour after feeding, feces were removed from all compartments using a siphon.
statement: 喂食一小时后，使用虹吸管从所有隔间移除粪便。
text_zh: 喂食一小时后，使用虹吸管从所有隔间移除粪便。
text_en: One hour after feeding, feces were removed from all compartments using a siphon.

quote: Body mass (to the nearest 0.01 g) and body length (to the nearest 0.1 cm) of individual fish were measured after the fish were slightly anesthetized with buffered tricaine methane sulphonate (MS-222, 50 mg l −1) at the end of each week during both the feeding and food-deprivation period.
statement: 在喂食和禁食期间的每周结束时，鱼经缓冲三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222，50 mg/l）轻度麻醉后，测量个体鱼的体重和体长。
text_zh: 在喂食和禁食期间的每周结束时，鱼经缓冲三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222，50 mg/l）轻度麻醉后，测量个体鱼的体重和体长。
text_en: At the end of each week during feeding and fasting periods, individual fish were measured for body weight and body length after being lightly anesthetized with buffered tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 50 mg/l).

quote: Hypoxic conditions trigger the sharp increase of reactive oxygen species and oxidative stress, resulting in protein, DNA, and lipid damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, and apoptosis
statement: 低氧条件会触发活性氧和氧化应激的急剧增加，导致蛋白质、DNA和脂质损伤、线粒体功能障碍以及细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 低氧条件会触发活性氧和氧化应激的急剧增加，导致蛋白质、DNA和脂质损伤、线粒体功能障碍以及细胞凋亡。
text_en: Hypoxic conditions trigger a sharp increase in reactive oxygen species and oxidative stress, leading to protein, DNA, and lipid damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, and apoptosis.

quote: Increased or decreased activity of antioxidant defense enzymes, such as superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione peroxidase (GPx), can be used to maintain organism balance and reduce cell damage
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）等抗氧化防御酶活性的增加或减少可用于维持机体平衡并减少细胞损伤。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）等抗氧化防御酶活性的增加或减少可用于维持机体平衡并减少细胞损伤。
text_en: The increase or decrease in the activity of antioxidant defense enzymes such as superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione peroxidase (GPx) can be used to maintain body balance and reduce cell damage.

quote: The fish were kept in three recirculating water tanks (length×width×height=1.2 m×0.6 m×0.6 m) for 4 weeks before the experiment, with a 12 h light:12 h dark cycle.
statement: 实验前将鱼饲养在三个循环水缸中4周，光照周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_zh: 实验前将鱼饲养在三个循环水缸中4周，光照周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were kept in three recirculating water tanks for 4 weeks, with a light cycle of 12 hours light: 12 hours dark.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 20.0±0.5°C, and the oxygen content was kept above 7.0 mg l −1 by using an air pump.
statement: 水温维持在20.0±0.5°C，并通过气泵将氧气含量保持在7.0 mg l−1以上。
text_zh: 水温维持在20.0±0.5°C，并通过气泵将氧气含量保持在7.0 mg l−1以上。
text_en: The water temperature was maintained at 20.0±0.5°C, and the oxygen content was kept above 7.0 mg l−1 by an air pump.

quote: Fish were fed to satiation once daily with Cyprinid fish diet... which was used for the entire experiment.
statement: 每天投喂鲤科鱼类饲料至饱食一次，该饲料用于整个实验期间。
text_zh: 每天投喂鲤科鱼类饲料至饱食一次，该饲料用于整个实验期间。
text_en: Cyprinid fish feed was fed to satiation once daily, and this feed was used throughout the entire experiment.

quote: This fish diet was made in the form of a sphere and could be natant on the surface of the water without dissolving for 12 h.
statement: 这种鱼饲料制成球形，可在水面漂浮12小时而不溶解。
text_zh: 这种鱼饲料制成球形，可在水面漂浮12小时而不溶解。
text_en: This fish feed is made into spheres and can float on the water surface for 12 hours without dissolving.

quote: all of the diet pellets were filtrated by using a screen mesh to acquire the same size of pellet (mean mass=0.016 g per pellet) before the experiment.
statement: 实验前使用筛网过滤所有饲料颗粒以获得相同大小的颗粒（平均质量=每粒0.016克）。
text_zh: 实验前使用筛网过滤所有饲料颗粒以获得相同大小的颗粒（平均质量=每粒0.016克）。
text_en: Before the experiment, all feed pellets were filtered through a sieve to obtain pellets of uniform size (average mass = 0.016 g per pellet).

quote: Before the formal experiment, the experimental fish were temporarily raised in a tank and fed a temporary diet (36% crude protein and 7% crude lipid) for 14 days to adapt to the experimental conditions.
statement: 实验前，鱼在暂养池中饲养并投喂临时饲料14天，以适应实验条件。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼在暂养池中饲养并投喂临时饲料14天，以适应实验条件。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were kept in holding tanks and fed temporary feed for 14 days to acclimate to experimental conditions.

quote: Before the start of the experiment, the experimental fish were removed after being starve
statement: 实验开始前，鱼经过饥饿处理后被移除（用于后续步骤）。
text_zh: 实验开始前，鱼经过饥饿处理后被移除（用于后续步骤）。
text_en: Before the experiment started, fish were removed after being subjected to starvation treatment (for subsequent steps).

quote: It has been reported that VC can improve the antioxidant, antiapoptotic, and immune abilities of the abalone Haliotis discus hannai Ino [ 21 ].
statement: 据报道，维生素C可以提高盘鲍的抗氧化、抗凋亡和免疫能力。
text_zh: 据报道，维生素C可以提高盘鲍的抗氧化、抗凋亡和免疫能力。
text_en: It is reported that vitamin C can improve the antioxidant, anti-apoptotic, and immune capabilities of abalone.
outcome: 抗氧化、抗凋亡及免疫能力

quote: When aquatic animals are starved of oxygen, they exhibit metabolic disorders and oxidative damage, ultimately leading to death [ 22 ].
statement: 当水生动物缺氧时，它们会出现代谢紊乱和氧化损伤，最终导致死亡。
text_zh: 当水生动物缺氧时，它们会出现代谢紊乱和氧化损伤，最终导致死亡。
text_en: When aquatic animals are hypoxic, they experience metabolic disorders and oxidative damage, ultimately leading to death.
outcome: 代谢紊乱、氧化损伤及死亡率

quote: Gibel carp may experience hypoxia in intensive culture; this not only harms the ecosystem and affects the diversity of aquatic resources, but it also causes large-scale asphyxia death of cultured fish.
statement: 鲫鱼在集约化养殖中可能会经历缺氧；这不仅破坏生态系统并影响水生资源多样性，还会导致养殖鱼类大规模窒息死亡。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在集约化养殖中可能会经历缺氧；这不仅破坏生态系统并影响水生资源多样性，还会导致养殖鱼类大规模窒息死亡。
text_en: Crucian carp may experience hypoxia in intensive culture; this not only disrupts the ecosystem and affects aquatic resource diversity, but also leads to mass suffocation deaths of farmed fish.
outcome: 缺氧导致的窒息死亡及生态影响

quote: The protein levels of HIF-1α, Nrf2, Keap1, and BiP/GRP78 in the liver tissue after hypoxic stress were detected by Western blotting.
statement: Western blotting was used to detect the protein levels of HIF-1α, Nrf2, Keap1, and BiP/GRP78 in liver tissue following hypoxic stress.
text_en: Western blotting was used to detect the protein levels of HIF-1α, Nrf2, Keap1, and BiP/GRP78 in liver tissue following hypoxic stress.

quote: The specific growth rate of fish was increased by the supplementation of VC.
statement: 补充维生素C提高了鱼类的特定生长率。
text_zh: 补充维生素C提高了鱼类的特定生长率。
text_en: Supplementing vitamin C improved the specific growth rate of fish.

quote: Plasma stress markers (glucose, lactic acid, and cortisol) were decreased by the VC supplementation.
statement: 补充维生素C降低了血浆应激标志物（葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇）的水平。
text_zh: 补充维生素C降低了血浆应激标志物（葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇）的水平。
text_en: Vitamin C supplementation reduced the levels of plasma stress markers (glucose, lactate and cortisol).

quote: Moreover, the levels of the inflammatory cytokines (tnf-α , il-2 , il-6 , and il-12) were increased by enhancing the Nrf2/Keap1 signaling pathway.
statement: 此外，通过增强Nrf2/Keap1信号通路，炎症细胞因子（tnf-α, il-2, il-6, il-12）的水平升高了。
text_zh: 此外，通过增强Nrf2/Keap1信号通路，炎症细胞因子（tnf-α, il-2, il-6, il-12）的水平升高了。
text_en: In addition, through enhancing the Nrf2/Keap1 signaling pathway, the levels of inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-2, IL-6, IL-12) increased.
counterevidence: 炎症细胞因子水平升高通常与负面健康结果相关，尽管此处归因于Nrf2通路的激活。

quote: Upregulation of the antioxidant enzymes activity (CAT, SOD, and GPx); T-AOC; and anti-inflammatory factors (il-4 and tgf-β) highlighted the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities of VC.
statement: 抗氧化酶活性（CAT, SOD, GPx）、总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）以及抗炎因子（il-4, tgf-β）的上调突显了维生素C的抗氧化和抗炎活性。
text_zh: 抗氧化酶活性（CAT, SOD, GPx）、总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）以及抗炎因子（il-4, tgf-β）的上调突显了维生素C的抗氧化和抗炎活性。
text_en: The upregulation of antioxidant enzyme activities (CAT, SOD, GPx), total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), and anti-inflammatory factors (il-4, tgf-β) highlights the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity of vitamin C.

quote: The results showed that VC reduced the apoptotic index of the fish hypothalamus.
statement: 结果显示，维生素C降低了鱼类下丘脑的凋亡指数。
text_zh: 结果显示，维生素C降低了鱼类下丘脑的凋亡指数。
text_en: The results showed that vitamin C reduced the apoptosis index in the fish hypothalamus.

quote: The expression of GRP78 protein in the liver and endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis induced by hypoxia were inhibited by VC.
statement: 维生素C抑制了肝脏中GRP78蛋白的表达以及由缺氧诱导的内质网应激和凋亡。
text_zh: 维生素C抑制了肝脏中GRP78蛋白的表达以及由缺氧诱导的内质网应激和凋亡。
text_en: Vitamin C inhibited the expression of GRP78 protein in the liver and endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis induced by hypoxia.

quote: fish were individually raised in 80 separated compartments (length×width×height=17×10×15 cm) in two independent cycling tank systems, which consisted of a large tank (length×width×height=1.1 m×1.1 m×0.8 m, volume=968 l) and a water filtration system.
statement: 鱼类在两个独立的循环水系统中，被分别饲养在80个分隔的隔间内。
text_zh: 鱼类在两个独立的循环水系统中，被分别饲养在80个分隔的隔间内。
text_en: Fish were housed in 80 separate compartments within two independent recirculating aquaculture systems.

population.system: indoor recirculating aquaculture system with individual compartments

quote: The ration of restricted feeding was 50% of the satiation feeding.
statement: 限制投喂组的投喂量为饱食组投喂量的50%。
text_zh: 限制投喂组的投喂量为饱食组投喂量的50%。
text_en: The feeding amount in the restricted feeding group was 50% of that in the satiation feeding group.

quote: After 3 weeks of the satiation and restricted feeding treatments, all experimental fish (n =71) were placed on a satiation diet twice daily for five days to reduce differences in nutrient status between SMR groups.
statement: 经过3周的饱食和限制投喂处理后，所有实验鱼每天两次饱食投喂持续五天，以减少标准代谢率（SMR）组之间的营养状态差异。
text_zh: 经过3周的饱食和限制投喂处理后，所有实验鱼每天两次饱食投喂持续五天，以减少标准代谢率（SMR）组之间的营养状态差异。
text_en: After 3 weeks of satiation and restricted feeding treatments, all experimental fish were fed to satiation twice daily for five days to reduce differences in nutritional status among standard metabolic rate (SMR) groups.

quote: All fish were then food deprived for the following 3 weeks.
statement: 随后所有鱼被禁食3周。
text_zh: 随后所有鱼被禁食3周。
text_en: All fish were then fasted for 3 weeks.

quote: Each day, 10% of the water in the cycling tank system was replaced by dechlorinated tap water.
statement: 每天用除氯自来水替换循环水系统中10%的水。
text_zh: 每天用除氯自来水替换循环水系统中10%的水。
text_en: Replace 10% of the water in the recirculating aquaculture system daily with dechlorinated tap water.

quote: All environmental conditions (e.g. temperature, oxygen concentration) of the cycling tank system were the same as during the acclimation period.
statement: 循环水系统的所有环境条件（如温度、氧气浓度）与驯化期间保持一致。
text_zh: 循环水系统的所有环境条件（如温度、氧气浓度）与驯化期间保持一致。
text_en: All environmental conditions in the recirculating aquaculture system (such as temperature and oxygen concentration) were kept consistent with those during the acclimation period.

quote: Fish were fed twice daily (9:00 h and 19:00 h) after they were transferred into the individual compartments.
statement: 鱼转入单独隔间后，每天定时投喂两次（9:00和19:00）。
text_zh: 鱼转入单独隔间后，每天定时投喂两次（9:00和19:00）。
text_en: After the fish were transferred to separate compartments, they were fed twice daily at scheduled times (9:00 and 19:00).

quote: The final body weight and specific growth rate of gibel carp fed the VC diet were significantly higher than those of the control group after eight weeks.
statement: 饲喂维生素C饲料的银鲫在八周后的终末体重和特定生长率显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 饲喂维生素C饲料的银鲫在八周后的终末体重和特定生长率显著高于对照组。
text_en: Silver crucian carp fed a vitamin C diet had significantly higher final body weight and specific growth rate after eight weeks compared to the control group.

quote: Compared with the control group, no significant differences in feed utilization rate or feed efficiency were found in the VC group.
statement: 与对照组相比，维生素C组的饲料利用率或饲料效率没有显著差异。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，维生素C组的饲料利用率或饲料效率没有显著差异。
text_en: Compared with the control group, there was no significant difference in feed utilization or feed efficiency in the vitamin C group.

quote: After being stressed in the hypoxic incubator for 3 h, the oxygen concentration in the cylinder was measured again; the oxygen concentration at this point was 0.08 ± 0.02 mg/L.
statement: 在缺氧孵化器中应激3小时后，缸内的氧气浓度降至0.08 ± 0.02 mg/L。
text_zh: 在缺氧孵化器中应激3小时后，缸内的氧气浓度降至0.08 ± 0.02 mg/L。
text_en: After 3 hours of stress in an anoxic incubator, the oxygen concentration in the tank dropped to 0.08 ± 0.02 mg/L.

quote: Blood was taken from the caudal vein using a syringe soaked with heparin sodium (concentration: 0.2%), put into an anticoagulation centrifuge tube, and centrifuged (3000× g at 4 °C) for 15 min.
statement: 使用浸泡过肝素钠的注射器从尾静脉采血，并在抗凝离心管中于4°C下以3000×g离心15分钟。
text_zh: 使用浸泡过肝素钠的注射器从尾静脉采血，并在抗凝离心管中于4°C下以3000×g离心15分钟。
text_en: Blood was collected from the tail vein using a syringe soaked in sodium heparin, and centrifuged at 3000×g for 15 minutes at 4°C in an anticoagulant centrifuge tube.

quote: The content of plasma cortisol was detected by enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) (H094) provided by the Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Research Institute.
statement: 血浆皮质醇含量通过南京建成生物工程研究所提供的酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）试剂盒进行检测。
text_zh: 血浆皮质醇含量通过南京建成生物工程研究所提供的酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）试剂盒进行检测。
text_en: Plasma cortisol content was detected using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) kits provided by Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute.

quote: The plasma glucose, lactic acid, and cortisol levels were increased significantly by acute hypoxia.
statement: 急性缺氧显著增加了血浆葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇水平。
text_zh: 急性缺氧显著增加了血浆葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇水平。
text_en: Acute hypoxia significantly increased plasma glucose, lactate, and cortisol levels.

quote: However, all of the levels were significantly decreased in the VC-supplemented group.
statement: 然而，在补充VC的组中，所有这些水平（血浆葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇）均显著降低。
text_zh: 然而，在补充VC的组中，所有这些水平（血浆葡萄糖、乳酸和皮质醇）均显著降低。
text_en: However, in the group supplemented with VC, all these levels (plasma glucose, lactate, and cortisol) were significantly reduced.

quote: An anoxic environment is closely related to the ER stress response.
statement: 缺氧环境与内质网应激反应密切相关。
text_zh: 缺氧环境与内质网应激反应密切相关。
text_en: Hypoxic environments are closely related to endoplasmic reticulum stress responses.

quote: In addition, VC deficiency can increase the levels of proinflammatory factors in grass carp and reduce the levels of anti-inflammatory factors, such as interleukin (IL) 10 and transforming growth factor (TGF) 1β.
statement: 此外，维生素C缺乏会增加草鱼促炎因子的水平，并降低白细胞介素(IL)10和转化生长因子(TGF)1β等抗炎因子的水平。
text_zh: 此外，维生素C缺乏会增加草鱼促炎因子的水平，并降低白细胞介素(IL)10和转化生长因子(TGF)1β等抗炎因子的水平。
text_en: In addition, vitamin C deficiency increases the levels of pro-inflammatory factors in grass carp and decreases the levels of anti-inflammatory factors such as interleukin (IL)10 and transforming growth factor (TGF)1β.

quote: VC supplementation significantly reduced the expression of hsp70 and increased the expression of sod , but it had no significant effect on the expression of gpx or cat .
statement: 维生素C补充显著降低了hsp70的表达并增加了sod的表达，但对gpx或cat的表达没有显著影响。
text_zh: 维生素C补充显著降低了hsp70的表达并增加了sod的表达，但对gpx或cat的表达没有显著影响。
text_en: Vitamin C supplementation significantly reduced hsp70 expression and increased sod expression, but had no significant effect on gpx or cat expression.
outcome: 应激与抗氧化相关基因表达
counterevidence: 对gpx或cat的表达没有显著影响
